                        'id', p.id,
                        'role', p.role,
                        'customer_id', p.customer_id,
                        'provider_id', p.provider_id,

                    )
                    ORDER BY p.role
                ), '[]'::jsonb)
                FROM public.billing_document_parties p
                WHERE p.document_id = d.id
            ),
            'lines', (
                SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(
                    jsonb_build_object(
                        'id', l.id,
                        'operation_id', l.operation_id,
                        'line_number', l.line_number,
                        'description', l.description,

                            ), '[]'::jsonb)
                            FROM public.billing_document_taxes t
                            WHERE t.line_id = l.id
                        )
                    )
                    ORDER BY l.line_number, l.created_at
                ), '[]'::jsonb)
                FROM public.billing_document_lines l
                WHERE l.document_id = d.id
            ),
            'global_taxes', (
                SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(
                    jsonb_build_object(
                        'id', t.id,
                        'tax_scope', t.tax_scope,
                        'tax_type', t.tax_type,
                        'tax_code', t.tax_code,
                        'factor_type', t.factor_type,
                        'rate_or_quota', t.rate_or_quota,
                        'base', t.base,
                        'amount', t.amount,
                        'metadata', t.metadata
                    )
                    ORDER BY t.tax_type, t.tax_code
                ), '[]'::jsonb)
                FROM public.billing_document_taxes t
                WHERE t.document_id = d.id
                  AND t.line_id IS NULL
            ),
            'outbox', (
                SELECT jsonb_build_object(
                    'id', o.id,
                    'status', o.status,
                    'provider_key', o.provider_key,
                    'idempotency_key', o.idempotency_key,
                    'attempt_count', o.attempt_count,

                    'last_attempt_at', o.last_attempt_at,
                    'last_error', o.last_error,
                    'created_at', o.created_at,
                    'updated_at', o.updated_at
                )
                FROM public.billing_api_outbox o
                WHERE o.document_id = d.id
                ORDER BY o.created_at DESC
                LIMIT 1
            )
        )
    END
    FROM private.fiscal02_legacy_billing_documents d
    WHERE d.id = p_document_id;
$function$

public.rpc_approve_payroll_period(uuid,.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_approve_payroll_period(p_tenant_id uuid, p_period_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_period public.payroll_periods%rowtype;
    v_invoice_id uuid;
    v_reference text;
    v_item record;
BEGIN
    IF NOT public.tanda3_user_has_role(p_tenant_id) THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'unauthorized');
    END IF;

    SELECT * INTO v_period
    FROM public.payroll_periods
    WHERE id = p_period_id AND tenant_id = p_tenant_id;

    IF v_period.id IS NULL THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'period_not_found');
    END IF;
    IF v_period.status = 'draft' THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'period_not_calculated');
    END IF;
    IF v_period.status IN ('paid', 'cancelled') THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'period_locked');
    END IF;

    v_reference := 'NOM-' || to_char(v_period.period_start, 'YYYYMMDD') || '-' || to_char(v_period.period_end, 'YYYYMMDD');
    v_invoice_id := v_period.finance_invoice_id;

    IF v_invoice_id IS NULL THEN
        INSERT INTO public.finance_invoices (
            tenant_id, direction, counterparty_name, reference, amount, currency,
            amount_mxn, exchange_rate, exchange_rate_date, exchange_rate_source,
            status, due_date, payroll_period_id
        )
        VALUES (
            p_tenant_id, 'ap', 'Nomina ' || v_period.name, v_reference, v_period.net_total, 'MXN',
            v_period.net_total, 1, v_period.period_end, 'manual',
            'open', v_period.period_end, p_period_id
        )
        RETURNING id INTO v_invoice_id;
    ELSE
        UPDATE public.finance_invoices
        SET
            counterparty_name = 'Nomina ' || v_period.name,
            reference = v_reference,
            amount = v_period.net_total,
            amount_mxn = v_period.net_total,
            exchange_rate = 1,
            exchange_rate_date = v_period.period_end,
            exchange_rate_source = 'manual',
            due_date = v_period.period_end,
            payroll_period_id = p_period_id
        WHERE id = v_invoice_id
          AND tenant_id = p_tenant_id
          AND status <> 'paid';
    END IF;

    IF v_period.status <> 'approved' THEN
        FOR v_item IN
            SELECT (i.metadata->>'loan_id')::uuid AS loan_id, i.amount
            FROM public.payroll_entry_items i
            JOIN public.payroll_entries e ON e.id = i.entry_id
            WHERE e.period_id = p_period_id
              AND i.item_type = 'loan'
              AND i.metadata ? 'loan_id'
        LOOP
            UPDATE public.payroll_loans
            SET
                outstanding_balance = GREATEST(outstanding_balance - v_item.amount, 0),
                status = CASE WHEN GREATEST(outstanding_balance - v_item.amount, 0) = 0 THEN 'paid' ELSE status END,
                updated_at = now()
            WHERE id = v_item.loan_id
              AND tenant_id = p_tenant_id
              AND status = 'open';
        END LOOP;
    END IF;

    UPDATE public.payroll_periods
    SET
        status = 'approved',
        finance_invoice_id = v_invoice_id,
        approved_at = COALESCE(approved_at, now()),
        approved_by = COALESCE(approved_by, auth.uid()),
        updated_at = now()
    WHERE id = p_period_id;

    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'id', p_period_id, 'finance_invoice_id', v_invoice_id);
END;
$function$

AS $function$
BEGIN

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_create_billing_document_from_operation(p_tenant_id uuid, p_operation_id uuid, p_options jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_operation public.operations%rowtype;
    v_customer public.customers%rowtype;
    v_provider public.logistics_providers%rowtype;
    v_profile public.billing_fiscal_profiles%rowtype;
    v_document_id uuid;
    v_existing_id uuid;
    v_document_type text := COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(p_options->>'document_type'), ''), 'cfdi_ingreso');
    v_direction text := COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(p_options->>'document_direction'), ''), 'ingreso');
    v_currency text;
    v_unit_price numeric(14,6);
    v_description text;
    v_line_id uuid;
    v_validation jsonb;
BEGIN
    IF NOT public.billing_user_has_tenant(p_tenant_id, ARRAY['admin', 'operator']) THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'unauthorized');
    END IF;

    SELECT *
    INTO v_operation
    FROM public.operations
    WHERE id = p_operation_id
      AND tenant_id = p_tenant_id;

    IF v_operation.id IS NULL THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'operation_not_found');
    END IF;

    SELECT id
    INTO v_existing_id
    FROM private.fiscal02_legacy_billing_documents
    WHERE tenant_id = p_tenant_id
      AND operation_id = p_operation_id
      AND document_type = v_document_type
      AND status IN ('draft', 'ready_for_api', 'queued', 'api_error')
    ORDER BY created_at DESC
    LIMIT 1;

    IF v_existing_id IS NOT NULL THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object(
            'success', true,
            'id', v_existing_id,
            'reused_existing', true,
            'document', public.billing_fiscal_document_json(v_existing_id)
        );
    END IF;

    IF v_operation.customer_id IS NOT NULL THEN
        SELECT *
        INTO v_customer
        FROM public.customers
        WHERE id = v_operation.customer_id
          AND tenant_id = p_tenant_id;
    END IF;

    IF v_operation.provider_id IS NOT NULL THEN
        SELECT *
        INTO v_provider
        FROM public.logistics_providers
        WHERE id = v_operation.provider_id
          AND tenant_id = p_tenant_id;
    END IF;

    SELECT *
    INTO v_profile
    FROM public.billing_fiscal_profiles
    WHERE tenant_id = p_tenant_id;

    v_currency := COALESCE(
        NULLIF(upper(trim(p_options->>'currency')), ''),
        NULLIF(upper(trim(v_operation.pricing_currency)), ''),
        NULLIF(upper(trim(v_profile.default_currency)), ''),
        'MXN'
    );

    v_unit_price := COALESCE(
        NULLIF(p_options->>'unit_price', '')::numeric,
        v_operation.customer_price_amount,
        0
    );

    v_description := COALESCE(
        NULLIF(trim(p_options->>'description'), ''),
        NULLIF(concat_ws(' - ',
            NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(v_operation.service_type, '')), ''),
            NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(v_operation.route_summary, '')), '')
        ), ''),
        'Servicio logistico'
    );

    INSERT INTO public.billing_documents (
        tenant_id,
        operation_id,
        customer_id,
        provider_id,
        document_direction,
        document_type,
        cfdi_version,
        status,
        serie,
        folio,
        payment_form_code,
        payment_method_code,
        cfdi_use_code,
        issuer_regime_code,
        receiver_regime_code,
        currency,
        exchange_rate,
        notes,
        source_snapshot,
        created_by
    ) VALUES (
        p_tenant_id,
        p_operation_id,
        v_operation.customer_id,
        v_operation.provider_id,
        v_direction,
        v_document_type,
        '4.0',
        'draft',
        COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(p_options->>'serie'), ''), v_profile.default_serie),
        NULLIF(trim(p_options->>'folio'), ''),
        COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(p_options->>'payment_form_code'), ''), v_profile.default_payment_form_code),
        COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(p_options->>'payment_method_code'), ''), v_profile.default_payment_method_code),
        COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(p_options->>'cfdi_use_code'), ''), v_profile.default_cfdi_use_code),
        v_profile.fiscal_regime_code,
        NULLIF(trim(p_options->>'receiver_regime_code'), ''),
        v_currency,
        NULLIF(p_options->>'exchange_rate', '')::numeric,
        p_options->>'notes',
        jsonb_build_object(
            'source', 'operation',
            'operation', jsonb_build_object(
                'id', v_operation.id,
                'reference_code', v_operation.reference_code,
                'status', v_operation.status,
                'client_display_name', v_operation.client_display_name,
                'customer_id', v_operation.customer_id,
                'route_summary', v_operation.route_summary,
                'origin_place', v_operation.origin_place,
                'destination_place', v_operation.destination_place,
                'operation_scope', v_operation.operation_scope,
                'execution_type', v_operation.execution_type,
                'provider_id', v_operation.provider_id,
                'provider_name', v_operation.provider_name,
                'external_driver', v_operation.external_driver,
                'external_vehicle', v_operation.external_vehicle,
                'service_type', v_operation.service_type,
                'provider_cost_amount', v_operation.provider_cost_amount,
                'customer_price_amount', v_operation.customer_price_amount,
                'pricing_currency', v_operation.pricing_currency
            ),
            'customer', CASE
                WHEN v_customer.id IS NULL THEN NULL
                ELSE jsonb_build_object(
                    'id', v_customer.id,
                    'display_name', v_customer.display_name,
                    'legal_name', v_customer.legal_name,
                    'tax_id', v_customer.tax_id,
                    'billing_email', v_customer.billing_email
                )
            END,
            'provider', CASE
                WHEN v_provider.id IS NULL THEN NULL
                ELSE jsonb_build_object(
                    'id', v_provider.id,
                    'display_name', v_provider.display_name,
                    'legal_name', v_provider.legal_name,
                    'tax_id', v_provider.tax_id,
                    'billing_email', v_provider.billing_email
                )
            END
        ),
        auth.uid()
    )
    RETURNING id INTO v_document_id;

    INSERT INTO public.billing_document_parties (
        tenant_id,
        document_id,
        role,
        rfc,
        legal_name,
        fiscal_regime_code,
        fiscal_postal_code,
        email,
        metadata
    ) VALUES (
        p_tenant_id,
        v_document_id,
        'issuer',
        v_profile.rfc,
        v_profile.legal_name,
        v_profile.fiscal_regime_code,
        v_profile.fiscal_postal_code,
        NULL,
        jsonb_build_object('source', 'billing_fiscal_profiles')
    );

    INSERT INTO public.billing_document_parties (
        tenant_id,
        document_id,
        role,
        customer_id,
        rfc,
        legal_name,
        fiscal_regime_code,
        fiscal_postal_code,
        email,
        metadata
    ) VALUES (
        p_tenant_id,
        v_document_id,
        'receiver',
        v_customer.id,
        v_customer.tax_id,
        COALESCE(v_customer.legal_name, v_customer.display_name, v_operation.client_display_name),
        NULLIF(trim(p_options->>'receiver_regime_code'), ''),
        NULLIF(trim(p_options->>'receiver_fiscal_postal_code'), ''),
        v_customer.billing_email,
        jsonb_build_object('source', 'customers')
    );

    IF v_provider.id IS NOT NULL THEN
        INSERT INTO public.billing_document_parties (
            tenant_id,
            document_id,
            role,
            provider_id,
            rfc,
            legal_name,
            email,
            metadata
        ) VALUES (
            p_tenant_id,
            v_document_id,
            'provider',
            v_provider.id,
            v_provider.tax_id,
            COALESCE(v_provider.legal_name, v_provider.display_name),
            v_provider.billing_email,
            jsonb_build_object('source', 'logistics_providers')
        );
    END IF;

    INSERT INTO public.billing_document_lines (
        tenant_id,
        document_id,
        operation_id,
        line_number,
        description,
        product_service_key,
        unit_key,
        unit_name,
        quantity,
        unit_price,
        discount,
        object_tax_code,
        metadata
    ) VALUES (
        p_tenant_id,
        v_document_id,
        p_operation_id,
        1,
        v_description,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(p_options->>'product_service_key'), ''), v_profile.default_product_service_key),
        COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(p_options->>'unit_key'), ''), v_profile.default_unit_key),
        COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(p_options->>'unit_name'), ''), 'Servicio'),
        COALESCE(NULLIF(p_options->>'quantity', '')::numeric, 1),
        v_unit_price,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(p_options->>'discount', '')::numeric, 0),
        COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(p_options->>'object_tax_code'), ''), v_profile.default_object_tax_code),
        jsonb_build_object('source', 'operation')
    )
    RETURNING id INTO v_line_id;

    IF v_profile.default_tax_rate IS NOT NULL
       AND COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(p_options->>'object_tax_code'), ''), v_profile.default_object_tax_code) = '02'
       AND v_unit_price > 0 THEN
        INSERT INTO public.billing_document_taxes (
            tenant_id,
            document_id,
            line_id,
            tax_scope,
            tax_type,
            tax_code,
            factor_type,
            rate_or_quota,
            base,
            amount,
            metadata
        ) VALUES (
            p_tenant_id,
            v_document_id,
            v_line_id,
            'line',
            'traslado',
            '002',
            'Tasa',
            v_profile.default_tax_rate,
            v_unit_price,
            round(v_unit_price * v_profile.default_tax_rate, 2),
            jsonb_build_object('source', 'billing_fiscal_profiles.default_tax_rate')
        );
    END IF;

    PERFORM public.billing_recalculate_document_totals(v_document_id);
    v_validation := public.rpc_validate_billing_document_for_api(v_document_id);

    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
        'success', true,
        'id', v_document_id,
        'reused_existing', false,
        'blockers', COALESCE(v_validation->'blockers', '[]'::jsonb),
        'warnings', COALESCE(v_validation->'warnings', '[]'::jsonb),
        'document', public.billing_fiscal_document_json(v_document_id)
    );
EXCEPTION WHEN unique_violation THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'billing_document_already_exists_for_operation');
WHEN OTHERS THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', SQLERRM);
END;
$function$

    IF NOT public.tanda2_user_has_role(p_tenant_id, ARRAY['admin', 'finance']) THEN

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_export_operations(p_tenant_id uuid, p_status_filter text[] DEFAULT NULL::text[], p_search_text text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_date_from text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_date_to text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_date_from timestamptz;
    v_date_to timestamptz;
    v_date_from_text text := NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(p_date_from, '')), '');
    v_date_to_text text := NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(p_date_to, '')), '');
BEGIN
    IF NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.memberships m
        WHERE m.user_id = auth.uid()
          AND m.tenant_id = p_tenant_id
    ) THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'unauthorized');
    END IF;

    IF v_date_from_text IS NOT NULL THEN
        v_date_from := v_date_from_text::timestamptz;
    END IF;

    IF v_date_to_text IS NOT NULL THEN
        IF v_date_to_text ~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$' THEN
            v_date_to := ((v_date_to_text::date + interval '1 day') - interval '1 microsecond')::timestamptz;
        ELSE
            v_date_to := v_date_to_text::timestamptz;
        END IF;
    END IF;

    IF v_date_from IS NOT NULL AND v_date_to IS NOT NULL AND v_date_from > v_date_to THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'invalid_date_range');
    END IF;

    RETURN (
        SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(
            jsonb_build_object(
                'operation_id', o.id,
                'reference_code', o.reference_code,
                'client_display_name', o.client_display_name,
                'status', o.status,
                'service_type', o.service_type,
                'route_summary', o.route_summary,
                'destination_city', o.destination_city,
                'execution_type', o.execution_type,
                'provider_name', COALESCE(o.provider_name, p.display_name),
                'external_driver_name', o.external_driver->>'name',
                'external_vehicle_ref', COALESCE(o.external_vehicle->>'ref', o.external_vehicle->>'plate'),
                'provider_cost_amount', o.provider_cost_amount,
                'customer_price_amount', o.customer_price_amount,
                'pricing_currency', o.pricing_currency,
                'profit_amount', CASE WHEN o.provider_cost_amount IS NULL OR o.customer_price_amount IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE o.customer_price_amount - o.provider_cost_amount END,
                'profit_margin_percent', CASE WHEN o.customer_price_amount IS NULL OR o.customer_price_amount = 0 OR o.provider_cost_amount IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE ((o.customer_price_amount - o.provider_cost_amount) / o.customer_price_amount) * 100 END,
                'driver_name', o.driver_name,
                'vehicle_ref', o.vehicle_ref,
                'operational_window_start', o.operational_window_start,
                'operational_window_end', o.operational_window_end,
                'created_at', o.created_at,
                'closed_at', o.closed_at,
                'cancelled_at', o.cancelled_at,
                'notes', o.notes
            )
            ORDER BY o.created_at DESC, o.reference_code DESC
        ), '[]'::jsonb)
        FROM public.operations o
        LEFT JOIN public.logistics_providers p ON p.id = o.provider_id
        WHERE o.tenant_id = p_tenant_id
          AND (p_status_filter IS NULL OR cardinality(p_status_filter) = 0 OR o.status = ANY (p_status_filter))
          AND (
                NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(p_search_text, '')), '') IS NULL
                OR o.reference_code ILIKE '%' || trim(p_search_text) || '%'
                OR COALESCE(o.client_display_name, '') ILIKE '%' || trim(p_search_text) || '%'
                OR COALESCE(o.route_summary, '') ILIKE '%' || trim(p_search_text) || '%'
                OR COALESCE(o.destination_city, '') ILIKE '%' || trim(p_search_text) || '%'
                OR COALESCE(o.driver_name, '') ILIKE '%' || trim(p_search_text) || '%'
                OR COALESCE(o.vehicle_ref, '') ILIKE '%' || trim(p_search_text) || '%'
                OR COALESCE(o.provider_name, p.display_name, '') ILIKE '%' || trim(p_search_text) || '%'
                OR COALESCE(o.service_type, '') ILIKE '%' || trim(p_search_text) || '%'
          )
          AND (v_date_from IS NULL OR o.created_at >= v_date_from)
          AND (v_date_to IS NULL OR o.created_at <= v_date_to)
    );
END;
$function$

                      OR NULLIF(d.quote_payload->>'provider_cost_amount', '') IS NULL
                        THEN NULL

    END IF;

    IF NOT public.tanda1_user_is_member(v_customer.tenant_id) THEN

        'billing_email', c.billing_email,
        'preferred_currency', c.preferred_currency,
        'notes', c.notes,
        'is_active', c.is_active,
        'deal_count', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.crm_deals d WHERE d.customer_id = c.id),
        'operation_count', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.operations o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id),
        'last_deal_at', (SELECT max(COALESCE(d.last_touch_at, d.updated_at, d.created_at)) FROM public.crm_deals d WHERE d.customer_id = c.id),
        'last_operation_at', (SELECT max(o.created_at) FROM public.operations o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id),
        'recent_deals', COALESCE((
            SELECT jsonb_agg(
                jsonb_build_object(
                    'id', d.id,
                    'title', d.title,
                    'company', d.company,
                    'stage', d.stage,
                    'quote_status', d.quote_status,
                    'quote_reference', d.quote_reference,
                    'converted_operation_id', d.converted_operation_id,
                    'updated_at', d.updated_at
                )
                ORDER BY d.updated_at DESC
            )
            FROM (
                SELECT *
                FROM public.crm_deals d
                WHERE d.customer_id = c.id
                ORDER BY d.updated_at DESC
                LIMIT 5
            ) d
        ), '[]'::jsonb),
        'recent_operations', COALESCE((
            SELECT jsonb_agg(
                jsonb_build_object(
                    'id', o.id,
                    'reference_code', o.reference_code,
                    'client_display_name', o.client_display_name,
                    'status', o.status,
                    'route_summary', o.route_summary,

                ORDER BY o.created_at DESC
            )
            FROM (
                SELECT *
                FROM public.operations o
                WHERE o.customer_id = c.id
                ORDER BY o.created_at DESC
                LIMIT 5
            ) o
        ), '[]'::jsonb),
        'created_at', c.created_at,
        'updated_at', c.updated_at
    )
    INTO v_result
    FROM public.customers c
    WHERE c.id = p_customer_id;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_get_daily_control_summary(p_tenant_id uuid, p_filters jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_items jsonb;
BEGIN
    v_items := public.rpc_list_daily_control_items(
        p_tenant_id,
        COALESCE(p_filters, '{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object('limit', 500)
    );

    IF v_items ? 'error' THEN
        RETURN v_items;
    END IF;

    RETURN (
        WITH items AS (
            SELECT *
            FROM jsonb_to_recordset(v_items) AS x(
                id text,
                item_source text,
                kind text,
                area text,
                priority text,
                status text,
                title text,
                subtitle text,
                due_date date,
                assigned_role text,
                assigned_user_id uuid,
                related_entity_type text,
                related_entity_id uuid,
                route text,
                is_overdue boolean,
                created_at timestamptz,
                metadata jsonb,
                priority_rank integer
            )
        )
        SELECT jsonb_build_object(
            'total', count(*),
            'open_total', count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('open', 'in_progress')),
            'overdue_total', count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_overdue),
            'critical_total', count(*) FILTER (WHERE priority = 'critical'),
            'high_total', count(*) FILTER (WHERE priority = 'high'),
            'manual_total', count(*) FILTER (WHERE item_source = 'manual'),
            'derived_total', count(*) FILTER (WHERE item_source = 'derived'),
            'by_area', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_object_agg(area, item_count) FROM (SELECT area, count(*) AS item_count FROM items GROUP BY area) a), '{}'::jsonb),
            'by_priority', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_object_agg(priority, item_count) FROM (SELECT priority, count(*) AS item_count FROM items GROUP BY priority) p), '{}'::jsonb),
            'by_status', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_object_agg(status, item_count) FROM (SELECT status, count(*) AS item_count FROM items GROUP BY status) s), '{}'::jsonb),
            'by_source', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_object_agg(item_source, item_count) FROM (SELECT item_source, count(*) AS item_count FROM items GROUP BY item_source) src), '{}'::jsonb)
        )
        FROM items
    );
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_get_dispatch_dashboard(p_tenant_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_active_count integer := 0;
    v_unassigned_count integer := 0;
    v_blocked_count integer := 0;
    v_incident_count integer := 0;
    v_tracking_ready_count integer := 0;
    v_open_incident_operations_count integer := 0;
    v_blocking_incident_operations_count integer := 0;
    v_delivered_ready_to_bill_count integer := 0;
    v_billing_blocked_count integer := 0;
    v_billed_count integer := 0;
    v_admin_closed_count integer := 0;
BEGIN
    IF NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.memberships m
        WHERE m.user_id = auth.uid()
          AND m.tenant_id = p_tenant_id
    ) THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'unauthorized');
    END IF;

    WITH ops AS (
        SELECT
            o.id,
            o.status,
            public.rpc_get_operation_dispatch_readiness(o.id) AS readiness,
            public.rpc_get_operation_incident_summary(o.id) AS incident_summary,
            public.rpc_get_operation_billing_summary(o.id) AS billing_summary
        FROM public.operations o
        WHERE o.tenant_id = p_tenant_id
    )
    SELECT
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('planned', 'assigned', 'in_transit')),
        count(*) FILTER (
            WHERE status = 'planned'
              AND NOT COALESCE((readiness->>'is_assignment_complete')::boolean, false)
        ),
        count(*) FILTER (
            WHERE jsonb_array_length(COALESCE(readiness->'blocking_reasons', '[]'::jsonb)) > 0
               OR COALESCE((incident_summary->>'has_blocking_incidents')::boolean, false)
        ),
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE((incident_summary->>'has_open_incidents')::boolean, false)),
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE((readiness->>'is_tracking_ready')::boolean, false)),
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE((incident_summary->>'has_open_incidents')::boolean, false)),
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE((incident_summary->>'has_blocking_incidents')::boolean, false)),
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'delivered' AND COALESCE((billing_summary->>'is_billing_ready')::boolean, false)),
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'delivered' AND NOT COALESCE((billing_summary->>'is_billing_ready')::boolean, false) AND NOT COALESCE((billing_summary->>'is_billed')::boolean, false)),
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE((billing_summary->>'is_billed')::boolean, false)),
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE((billing_summary->>'is_admin_closed')::boolean, false))
    INTO
        v_active_count,
        v_unassigned_count,
        v_blocked_count,
        v_incident_count,
        v_tracking_ready_count,
        v_open_incident_operations_count,
        v_blocking_incident_operations_count,
        v_delivered_ready_to_bill_count,
        v_billing_blocked_count,
        v_billed_count,
        v_admin_closed_count
    FROM ops;

    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
        'active_count', COALESCE(v_active_count, 0),
        'unassigned_count', COALESCE(v_unassigned_count, 0),
        'blocked_count', COALESCE(v_blocked_count, 0),
        'incident_count', COALESCE(v_incident_count, 0),
        'tracking_ready_count', COALESCE(v_tracking_ready_count, 0),
        'open_incident_operations_count', COALESCE(v_open_incident_operations_count, 0),
        'blocking_incident_operations_count', COALESCE(v_blocking_incident_operations_count, 0),
        'delivered_ready_to_bill_count', COALESCE(v_delivered_ready_to_bill_count, 0),
        'billing_blocked_count', COALESCE(v_billing_blocked_count, 0),
        'billed_count', COALESCE(v_billed_count, 0),
        'admin_closed_count', COALESCE(v_admin_closed_count, 0)
    );
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_get_executive_dashboard(p_tenant_id uuid, p_filters jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_date_preset text := COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(p_filters->>'date_preset', '')), ''), 'last_7_days');
    v_date_from timestamptz;
    v_date_to timestamptz;
BEGIN
    IF NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.memberships m
        WHERE m.user_id = auth.uid()
          AND m.tenant_id = p_tenant_id
    ) THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'unauthorized');
    END IF;

    IF NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(p_filters->>'date_from', '')), '') IS NOT NULL THEN
        v_date_from := (p_filters->>'date_from')::timestamptz;
    ELSE
        CASE v_date_preset
            WHEN 'today' THEN
                v_date_from := date_trunc('day', now());
            WHEN 'last_30_days' THEN
                v_date_from := now() - interval '30 days';
            WHEN 'this_month' THEN
                v_date_from := date_trunc('month', now());
            WHEN 'this_year' THEN
                v_date_from := date_trunc('year', now());
            ELSE
                v_date_from := now() - interval '7 days';
        END CASE;
    END IF;

    IF NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(p_filters->>'date_to', '')), '') IS NOT NULL THEN
        v_date_to := (p_filters->>'date_to')::timestamptz;
    ELSE
        v_date_to := now();
    END IF;

    IF v_date_from > v_date_to THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'invalid_date_range');
    END IF;

    RETURN (
        WITH ops_base AS (
            SELECT
                o.id,
                o.tenant_id,
                o.reference_code,
                o.client_display_name,
                o.status,
                o.created_at,
                o.closed_at,
                o.cancelled_at,
                o.source_deal_id,
                o.driver_id,
                o.vehicle_id,
                o.planned_departure,
                o.service_type,
                o.origin_place,
                o.destination_place,
                o.operational_window_start,
                o.operational_window_end,
                o.route_summary,
                o.destination_city
            FROM public.operations o
            WHERE o.tenant_id = p_tenant_id
        ),
        open_incidents AS (
            SELECT
                i.operation_id,
                count(*) FILTER (WHERE i.status = 'open') AS open_incident_count,
                count(*) FILTER (WHERE i.status = 'open' AND i.is_blocking = true) AS blocking_incident_count
            FROM public.operation_incidents i
            INNER JOIN ops_base o ON o.id = i.operation_id
            GROUP BY i.operation_id
        ),
        missing_docs AS (
            SELECT
                d.operation_id,
                count(*) FILTER (
                    WHERE d.requirement_level = 'required'
                      AND d.status = 'missing'
                ) AS missing_required_count
            FROM public.operation_documents d
            INNER JOIN ops_base o ON o.id = d.operation_id
            GROUP BY d.operation_id
        ),
        token_flags AS (
            SELECT
                t.operation_id,
                bool_or(t.scope = 'driver:write' AND t.state = 'active' AND t.expires_at > now()) AS has_driver_token,
                bool_or(t.scope = 'public:read' AND t.state = 'active' AND t.expires_at > now()) AS has_public_token
            FROM public.tracking_tokens t
            INNER JOIN ops_base o ON o.id = t.operation_id
            GROUP BY t.operation_id
        ),
        active_driver_usage AS (
            SELECT
                o.driver_id,
                count(*) AS active_count
            FROM ops_base o
            WHERE o.driver_id IS NOT NULL
              AND o.status IN ('assigned', 'in_transit')
            GROUP BY o.driver_id
        ),
        active_vehicle_usage AS (
            SELECT
                o.vehicle_id,
                count(*) AS active_count
            FROM ops_base o
            WHERE o.vehicle_id IS NOT NULL
              AND o.status IN ('assigned', 'in_transit')
            GROUP BY o.vehicle_id
        ),
        op_flags AS (
            SELECT
                o.id,
                o.reference_code,
                o.client_display_name,
                o.status,
                o.created_at,
                o.source_deal_id,
                o.driver_id,
                o.vehicle_id,
                COALESCE(oi.open_incident_count, 0) AS open_incident_count,
                COALESCE(oi.blocking_incident_count, 0) AS blocking_incident_count,
                COALESCE(md.missing_required_count, 0) AS missing_required_count,
                ob.status AS billing_status,
                ob.admin_closed_at,
                (
                    NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(o.service_type, '')), '') IS NOT NULL
                    AND o.origin_place IS NOT NULL
                    AND o.destination_place IS NOT NULL
                    AND o.operational_window_start IS NOT NULL
                    AND o.operational_window_end IS NOT NULL
                    AND NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(o.route_summary, '')), '') IS NOT NULL
                    AND NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(o.destination_city, '')), '') IS NOT NULL
                ) AS planning_complete,
                (
                    o.driver_id IS NOT NULL
                    AND o.vehicle_id IS NOT NULL
                    AND o.planned_departure IS NOT NULL
                ) AS assignment_complete,
                COALESCE(tf.has_driver_token, false) AS has_driver_token,
                COALESCE(tf.has_public_token, false) AS has_public_token,
                d.status AS driver_status,
                d.is_active AS driver_is_active,
                v.status AS vehicle_status,
                v.is_active AS vehicle_is_active,
                CASE
                    WHEN o.driver_id IS NULL THEN false
                    ELSE COALESCE(adu.active_count, 0) > CASE WHEN o.status IN ('assigned', 'in_transit') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                END AS driver_occupied_elsewhere,
                CASE
                    WHEN o.vehicle_id IS NULL THEN false
                    ELSE COALESCE(avu.active_count, 0) > CASE WHEN o.status IN ('assigned', 'in_transit') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                END AS vehicle_occupied_elsewhere
            FROM ops_base o
            LEFT JOIN open_incidents oi ON oi.operation_id = o.id
            LEFT JOIN missing_docs md ON md.operation_id = o.id
            LEFT JOIN public.operation_billing ob ON ob.operation_id = o.id
            LEFT JOIN token_flags tf ON tf.operation_id = o.id
            LEFT JOIN public.drivers d
                ON d.id = o.driver_id
               AND d.tenant_id = p_tenant_id
            LEFT JOIN public.vehicles v
                ON v.id = o.vehicle_id
               AND v.tenant_id = p_tenant_id
            LEFT JOIN active_driver_usage adu ON adu.driver_id = o.driver_id
            LEFT JOIN active_vehicle_usage avu ON avu.vehicle_id = o.vehicle_id
        ),
        op_ready AS (
            SELECT
                o.*,
                CASE
                    WHEN o.driver_id IS NULL THEN true
                    ELSE COALESCE(o.driver_is_active, false) = true
                        AND o.driver_status = 'available'
                        AND NOT o.driver_occupied_elsewhere
                END AS driver_ok,
                CASE
                    WHEN o.vehicle_id IS NULL THEN true
                    ELSE COALESCE(o.vehicle_is_active, false) = true
                        AND o.vehicle_status = 'available'
                        AND NOT o.vehicle_occupied_elsewhere
                END AS vehicle_ok,
                (
                    o.assignment_complete
                    AND o.has_driver_token
                    AND o.has_public_token
                ) AS tracking_ready
            FROM op_flags o
        ),
        op_summary AS (
            SELECT
                o.*,
                (
                    o.status IN ('planned', 'assigned', 'in_transit')
                    AND (
                        NOT o.planning_complete
                        OR NOT o.assignment_complete
                        OR (o.driver_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT o.driver_ok)
                        OR (o.vehicle_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT o.vehicle_ok)
                        OR (o.status = 'assigned' AND NOT o.tracking_ready)
                    )
                ) AS has_dispatch_blocker,
                (
                    o.status = 'delivered'
                    AND o.blocking_incident_count = 0
                    AND NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(o.client_display_name, '')), '') IS NOT NULL
                    AND NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(o.reference_code, '')), '') IS NOT NULL
                    AND COALESCE(o.billing_status, 'draft') NOT IN ('issued', 'voided')
                ) AS is_billing_ready,
                (o.billing_status = 'issued') AS is_billed,
                (o.status = 'closed' OR o.admin_closed_at IS NOT NULL) AS is_admin_closed
            FROM op_ready o
        ),
        exec_counts AS (
            SELECT
                count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('planned', 'assigned', 'in_transit')) AS active_operations,
                count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'delivered') AS delivered_operations,
                count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'closed') AS closed_operations,
                count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'cancelled') AS cancelled_operations,
                count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_billing_ready) AS billing_ready_operations,
                count(*) FILTER (
                    WHERE status = 'delivered'
                      AND NOT is_billing_ready
                      AND NOT is_billed
                ) AS billing_blocked_operations,
                count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_billed) AS billed_operations,
                count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_admin_closed) AS admin_closed_operations,
                count(*) FILTER (WHERE open_incident_count > 0) AS open_incident_operations,
                count(*) FILTER (WHERE blocking_incident_count > 0) AS blocking_incident_operations,
                count(*) FILTER (WHERE missing_required_count > 0) AS operations_with_missing_required_documents
            FROM op_summary
        ),
        commercial_snapshot AS (
            SELECT
                count(*) FILTER (WHERE d.quote_status = 'draft') AS quotes_draft,
                count(*) FILTER (WHERE d.quote_status = 'in_review') AS quotes_in_review,
                count(*) FILTER (WHERE d.quote_status = 'rejected') AS quotes_rejected,
                count(*) FILTER (WHERE d.quote_status = 'approved' AND d.converted_operation_id IS NULL) AS quotes_pending_conversion
            FROM public.crm_deals d
            WHERE d.tenant_id = p_tenant_id
        ),
        commercial_period AS (
            SELECT
                count(*) FILTER (
                    WHERE d.approved_at IS NOT NULL
                      AND d.approved_at >= v_date_from
                      AND d.approved_at <= v_date_to
                ) AS quotes_approved,
                count(*) FILTER (
                    WHERE d.converted_at IS NOT NULL
                      AND d.converted_at >= v_date_from
                      AND d.converted_at <= v_date_to
                ) AS quotes_converted,
                count(*) FILTER (
                    WHERE d.approved_at IS NOT NULL
                      AND d.approved_at >= v_date_from
                      AND d.approved_at <= v_date_to
                      AND d.converted_operation_id IS NOT NULL
                ) AS approved_in_period_currently_converted
            FROM public.crm_deals d
            WHERE d.tenant_id = p_tenant_id
        ),
        operations_period AS (
            SELECT
                count(*) FILTER (
                    WHERE o.created_at >= v_date_from
                      AND o.created_at <= v_date_to
                      AND o.source_deal_id IS NOT NULL
                ) AS operations_from_quote,
                count(*) FILTER (
                    WHERE o.created_at >= v_date_from
                      AND o.created_at <= v_date_to
                      AND o.source_deal_id IS NULL
                ) AS manual_operations
            FROM public.operations o
            WHERE o.tenant_id = p_tenant_id
        ),
        resource_counts AS (
            SELECT
                (
                    SELECT count(*)
                    FROM public.drivers d
                    LEFT JOIN active_driver_usage adu ON adu.driver_id = d.id
                    WHERE d.tenant_id = p_tenant_id
                      AND d.status = 'available'
                      AND COALESCE(adu.active_count, 0) = 0
                ) AS drivers_available,
                (
                    SELECT count(*)
                    FROM public.drivers d
                    LEFT JOIN active_driver_usage adu ON adu.driver_id = d.id
                    WHERE d.tenant_id = p_tenant_id
                      AND d.status = 'available'
                      AND COALESCE(adu.active_count, 0) > 0
                ) AS drivers_assigned,
                (
                    SELECT count(*)
                    FROM public.drivers d
                    WHERE d.tenant_id = p_tenant_id
                      AND d.status = 'unavailable'
                ) AS drivers_unavailable,
                (
                    SELECT count(*)
                    FROM public.drivers d
                    WHERE d.tenant_id = p_tenant_id
                      AND d.status = 'inactive'
                ) AS drivers_inactive,
                (
                    SELECT count(*)
                    FROM public.vehicles v
                    LEFT JOIN active_vehicle_usage avu ON avu.vehicle_id = v.id
                    WHERE v.tenant_id = p_tenant_id
                      AND v.status = 'available'
                      AND COALESCE(avu.active_count, 0) = 0
                ) AS vehicles_available,
                (
                    SELECT count(*)
                    FROM public.vehicles v
                    LEFT JOIN active_vehicle_usage avu ON avu.vehicle_id = v.id
                    WHERE v.tenant_id = p_tenant_id
                      AND v.status = 'available'
                      AND COALESCE(avu.active_count, 0) > 0
                ) AS vehicles_assigned,
                (
                    SELECT count(*)
                    FROM public.vehicles v
                    WHERE v.tenant_id = p_tenant_id
                      AND v.status = 'unavailable'
                ) AS vehicles_unavailable,
                (
                    SELECT count(*)
                    FROM public.vehicles v
                    WHERE v.tenant_id = p_tenant_id
                      AND v.status = 'maintenance'
                ) AS vehicles_maintenance,
                (
                    SELECT count(*)
                    FROM public.vehicles v
                    WHERE v.tenant_id = p_tenant_id
                      AND v.status = 'inactive'
                ) AS vehicles_inactive
        ),
        blocker_counts AS (
            SELECT *
            FROM (
                SELECT 'dispatch_blocked'::text AS blocker_code, 'Operaciones bloqueadas para despacho'::text AS label, count(*)::integer AS count
                FROM op_summary
                WHERE has_dispatch_blocker

                UNION ALL

                SELECT 'blocking_incidents'::text, 'Operaciones con incidencias bloqueantes', count(*)::integer
                FROM op_summary
                WHERE blocking_incident_count > 0

                UNION ALL

                SELECT 'documents_missing_required'::text, 'Documentos requeridos faltantes', count(*)::integer
                FROM op_summary
                WHERE missing_required_count > 0

                UNION ALL

                SELECT 'billing_blocked'::text, 'Operaciones entregadas con billing bloqueado', count(*)::integer
                FROM op_summary
                WHERE status = 'delivered'
                  AND NOT is_billing_ready
                  AND NOT is_billed

                UNION ALL

                SELECT 'quotes_pending_conversion'::text, 'Quotes aprobadas sin convertir', quotes_pending_conversion::integer
                FROM commercial_snapshot
            ) counts
            WHERE count > 0
            ORDER BY count DESC, label ASC
            LIMIT 5
        ),
        priority_operation_candidates AS (
            SELECT
                CASE
                    WHEN o.status = 'delivered' AND NOT o.is_billing_ready AND NOT o.is_billed THEN 'operation_delivered_billing_blocked'
                    WHEN o.blocking_incident_count > 0 THEN 'operation_blocking_incident'
                    WHEN o.status IN ('planned', 'assigned', 'in_transit') AND o.has_dispatch_blocker THEN 'operation_dispatch_blocked'
                    WHEN o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'closed') AND o.missing_required_count > 0 THEN 'operation_missing_required_documents'
                    ELSE NULL
                END AS kind,
                CASE
                    WHEN o.status = 'delivered' AND NOT o.is_billing_ready AND NOT o.is_billed THEN 'critical'
                    WHEN o.blocking_incident_count > 0 THEN 'critical'
                    WHEN o.status IN ('planned', 'assigned', 'in_transit') AND o.has_dispatch_blocker THEN 'high'
                    ELSE 'medium'
                END AS severity,
                CASE
                    WHEN o.status = 'delivered' AND NOT o.is_billing_ready AND NOT o.is_billed THEN 100
                    WHEN o.blocking_incident_count > 0 THEN 90
                    WHEN o.status IN ('planned', 'assigned', 'in_transit') AND o.has_dispatch_blocker THEN 80
                    WHEN o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'closed') AND o.missing_required_count > 0 THEN 70
                    ELSE 0
                END AS priority_rank,
                o.operation_id AS operation_id,
                NULL::uuid AS deal_id,
                o.reference_code,
                CASE
                    WHEN o.status = 'delivered' AND NOT o.is_billing_ready AND NOT o.is_billed THEN 'Operacion entregada con billing bloqueado'
                    WHEN o.blocking_incident_count > 0 THEN 'Operacion con incidencia bloqueante abierta'
                    WHEN o.status IN ('planned', 'assigned', 'in_transit') AND o.has_dispatch_blocker THEN 'Operacion bloqueada para despacho'
                    ELSE 'Operacion con documentos requeridos faltantes'
                END AS title,
                CASE
                    WHEN o.status = 'delivered' AND NOT o.is_billing_ready AND NOT o.is_billed THEN 'Entregada sin cumplir condiciones minimas para facturacion'
                    WHEN o.blocking_incident_count > 0 THEN o.blocking_incident_count::text || ' incidencia(s) bloqueantes abiertas'
                    WHEN o.status IN ('planned', 'assigned', 'in_transit') AND o.has_dispatch_blocker THEN 'Falta preparar tracking, planeacion o asignacion valida'
                    ELSE o.missing_required_count::text || ' documento(s) requeridos pendientes'
                END AS subtitle,
                CASE
                    WHEN o.status = 'delivered' AND NOT o.is_billing_ready AND NOT o.is_billed THEN '/operations?operationId=' || o.operation_id::text || '&billing=blocked'
                    WHEN o.blocking_incident_count > 0 THEN '/operations?operationId=' || o.operation_id::text || '&incidents=blocking'
                    WHEN o.status IN ('planned', 'assigned', 'in_transit') AND o.has_dispatch_blocker THEN '/operations?operationId=' || o.operation_id::text || '&readiness=blocked'
                    ELSE '/operations?operationId=' || o.operation_id::text || '&documents=docs_missing_required'
                END AS route,
                o.status,
                'operations'::text AS recommended_target,
                CASE
                    WHEN o.status = 'delivered' AND NOT o.is_billing_ready AND NOT o.is_billed THEN 'billing=blocked'
                    WHEN o.blocking_incident_count > 0 THEN 'incidents=blocking'
                    WHEN o.status IN ('planned', 'assigned', 'in_transit') AND o.has_dispatch_blocker THEN 'readiness=blocked'
                    ELSE 'documents=docs_missing_required'
                END AS recommended_filter,
                o.created_at AS sort_at
            FROM (
                SELECT
                    op.id AS operation_id,
                    op.reference_code,
                    op.status,
                    op.created_at,
                    op.blocking_incident_count,
                    op.missing_required_count,
                    op.has_dispatch_blocker,
                    op.is_billing_ready,
                    op.is_billed
                FROM op_summary op
            ) o
            WHERE (
                (o.status = 'delivered' AND NOT o.is_billing_ready AND NOT o.is_billed)
                OR o.blocking_incident_count > 0
                OR (o.status IN ('planned', 'assigned', 'in_transit') AND o.has_dispatch_blocker)
                OR (o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'closed') AND o.missing_required_count > 0)
            )
        ),
        priority_quote_candidates AS (
            SELECT
                'quote_approved_pending_conversion'::text AS kind,
                'medium'::text AS severity,
                60 AS priority_rank,
                NULL::uuid AS operation_id,
                d.id AS deal_id,
                COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(d.quote_reference, '')), ''), d.title) AS reference_code,
                'Quote aprobada pendiente de convertir'::text AS title,
                COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(d.company, '')), ''), 'Lista para crear operacion') AS subtitle,
                '/commercial?dealId=' || d.id::text || '&quoteStatus=approved&converted=pending' AS route,
                d.quote_status AS status,
                'commercial'::text AS recommended_target,
                'quoteStatus=approved&converted=pending'::text AS recommended_filter,
                d.approved_at AS sort_at
            FROM public.crm_deals d
            WHERE d.tenant_id = p_tenant_id
              AND d.quote_status = 'approved'
              AND d.converted_operation_id IS NULL
        ),
        priority_attention AS (
            SELECT *
            FROM (
                SELECT * FROM priority_operation_candidates
                UNION ALL
                SELECT * FROM priority_quote_candidates
            ) items
            ORDER BY priority_rank DESC, sort_at DESC NULLS LAST
            LIMIT 10
        )
        SELECT jsonb_build_object(
            'filters', jsonb_build_object(
                'date_preset', v_date_preset,
                'date_from', v_date_from,
                'date_to', v_date_to
            ),
            'executive_kpis', jsonb_build_object(
                'active_operations', COALESCE(exec_counts.active_operations, 0),
                'delivered_operations', COALESCE(exec_counts.delivered_operations, 0),
                'closed_operations', COALESCE(exec_counts.closed_operations, 0),
                'cancelled_operations', COALESCE(exec_counts.cancelled_operations, 0),
                'billing_ready_operations', COALESCE(exec_counts.billing_ready_operations, 0),
                'billing_blocked_operations', COALESCE(exec_counts.billing_blocked_operations, 0),
                'billed_operations', COALESCE(exec_counts.billed_operations, 0),
                'admin_closed_operations', COALESCE(exec_counts.admin_closed_operations, 0),
                'open_incident_operations', COALESCE(exec_counts.open_incident_operations, 0),
                'blocking_incident_operations', COALESCE(exec_counts.blocking_incident_operations, 0),
                'operations_with_missing_required_documents', COALESCE(exec_counts.operations_with_missing_required_documents, 0),
                'occupied_drivers', COALESCE(resource_counts.drivers_assigned, 0),
                'occupied_vehicles', COALESCE(resource_counts.vehicles_assigned, 0)
            ),
            'commercial_kpis', jsonb_build_object(
                'quotes_draft', COALESCE(commercial_snapshot.quotes_draft, 0),
                'quotes_in_review', COALESCE(commercial_snapshot.quotes_in_review, 0),
                'quotes_approved', COALESCE(commercial_period.quotes_approved, 0),
                'quotes_converted', COALESCE(commercial_period.quotes_converted, 0),
                'quotes_rejected', COALESCE(commercial_snapshot.quotes_rejected, 0),
                'quote_to_operation_conversion_rate', CASE
                    WHEN COALESCE(commercial_period.quotes_approved, 0) = 0 THEN 0
                    ELSE round((commercial_period.approved_in_period_currently_converted::numeric / commercial_period.quotes_approved::numeric) * 100, 1)
                END,
                'operations_from_quote', COALESCE(operations_period.operations_from_quote, 0),
                'manual_operations', COALESCE(operations_period.manual_operations, 0)
            ),
            'resource_kpis', jsonb_build_object(
                'drivers_available', COALESCE(resource_counts.drivers_available, 0),
                'drivers_assigned', COALESCE(resource_counts.drivers_assigned, 0),
                'drivers_unavailable', COALESCE(resource_counts.drivers_unavailable, 0),
                'drivers_inactive', COALESCE(resource_counts.drivers_inactive, 0),
                'vehicles_available', COALESCE(resource_counts.vehicles_available, 0),
                'vehicles_assigned', COALESCE(resource_counts.vehicles_assigned, 0),
                'vehicles_unavailable', COALESCE(resource_counts.vehicles_unavailable, 0),
                'vehicles_maintenance', COALESCE(resource_counts.vehicles_maintenance, 0),
                'vehicles_inactive', COALESCE(resource_counts.vehicles_inactive, 0)
            ),
            'top_blockers', COALESCE((
                SELECT jsonb_agg(
                    jsonb_build_object(
                        'blocker_code', b.blocker_code,
                        'label', b.label,
                        'count', b.count
                    )
                    ORDER BY b.count DESC, b.label ASC
                )
                FROM blocker_counts b
            ), '[]'::jsonb),
            'priority_attention', COALESCE((
                SELECT jsonb_agg(
                    jsonb_build_object(
                        'kind', p.kind,
                        'severity', p.severity,
                        'operation_id', p.operation_id,
                        'deal_id', p.deal_id,
                        'reference_code', p.reference_code,
                        'title', p.title,
                        'subtitle', p.subtitle,
                        'route', p.route,
                        'status', p.status,
                        'recommended_target', p.recommended_target,
                        'recommended_filter', p.recommended_filter
                    )
                    ORDER BY p.priority_rank DESC, p.sort_at DESC NULLS LAST
                )
                FROM priority_attention p
            ), '[]'::jsonb)
        )
        FROM exec_counts
        CROSS JOIN commercial_snapshot
        CROSS JOIN commercial_period
        CROSS JOIN operations_period
        CROSS JOIN resource_counts
    );
END;
$function$
