CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_list_daily_control_items(p_tenant_id uuid, p_filters jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_role text := public.tanda6_user_role(p_tenant_id);
    v_filter_area text := NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(p_filters->>'area', '')), '');
    v_filter_priority text := NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(p_filters->>'priority', '')), '');
    v_filter_status text := NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(p_filters->>'status', '')), '');
    v_filter_source text := NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(p_filters->>'source', '')), '');
    v_filter_assigned_role text := NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(p_filters->>'assigned_role', '')), '');
    v_filter_overdue boolean := CASE WHEN p_filters ? 'overdue' THEN (p_filters->>'overdue')::boolean ELSE NULL END;
    v_limit integer := LEAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF(p_filters->>'limit', '')::integer, 200), 1), 500);
BEGIN
    IF v_role IS NULL THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'unauthorized');
    END IF;

    RETURN (
        WITH ops_base AS (
            SELECT
                o.id,
                o.reference_code,
                o.client_display_name,
                o.status,
                o.created_at,
                o.driver_id,
                o.vehicle_id,
                o.planned_departure,
                o.service_type,
                o.origin_place,
                o.destination_place,
                o.operational_window_start,
                o.operational_window_end,
                o.route_summary,
                o.destination_city
            FROM public.operations o
            WHERE o.tenant_id = p_tenant_id
              AND o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'closed')
        ),
        open_incidents AS (
            SELECT
                i.operation_id,
                count(*) FILTER (WHERE i.status = 'open') AS open_count,
                count(*) FILTER (WHERE i.status = 'open' AND i.is_blocking = true) AS blocking_count
            FROM public.operation_incidents i
            INNER JOIN ops_base o ON o.id = i.operation_id
            GROUP BY i.operation_id
        ),
        missing_docs AS (
            SELECT
                d.operation_id,
                count(*) FILTER (WHERE d.requirement_level = 'required' AND d.status = 'missing') AS missing_required_count
            FROM public.operation_documents d
            INNER JOIN ops_base o ON o.id = d.operation_id
            GROUP BY d.operation_id
        ),
        op_summary AS (
            SELECT
                o.id,
                o.reference_code,
                o.client_display_name,
                o.status,
                o.created_at,
                COALESCE(i.open_count, 0) AS open_incident_count,
                COALESCE(i.blocking_count, 0) AS blocking_incident_count,
                COALESCE(d.missing_required_count, 0) AS missing_required_count,
                COALESCE(ob.status, 'draft') AS billing_status,
                ob.admin_closed_at,
                (
                    o.status IN ('planned', 'assigned', 'in_transit')
                    AND (
                        NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(o.service_type, '')), '') IS NULL
                        OR o.origin_place IS NULL
                        OR o.destination_place IS NULL
                        OR o.operational_window_start IS NULL
                        OR o.operational_window_end IS NULL
                        OR NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(o.route_summary, '')), '') IS NULL
                        OR NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(o.destination_city, '')), '') IS NULL
                        OR o.driver_id IS NULL
                        OR o.vehicle_id IS NULL
                        OR o.planned_departure IS NULL
                    )
                ) AS has_dispatch_blocker,
                (
                    o.status = 'delivered'
                    AND COALESCE(i.blocking_count, 0) = 0
                    AND NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(o.client_display_name, '')), '') IS NOT NULL
                    AND NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(o.reference_code, '')), '') IS NOT NULL
                    AND COALESCE(ob.status, 'draft') NOT IN ('issued', 'voided')
                ) AS is_billing_ready,
                COALESCE(ob.status, 'draft') = 'issued' AS is_billed
            FROM ops_base o
            LEFT JOIN open_incidents i ON i.operation_id = o.id
            LEFT JOIN missing_docs d ON d.operation_id = o.id
            LEFT JOIN public.operation_billing ob ON ob.operation_id = o.id
        ),
        operation_items AS (
            SELECT
                ('derived:operation_dispatch_blocked:' || o.id::text) AS id,
                'derived'::text AS item_source,
                'operation_dispatch_blocked'::text AS kind,
                'operations'::text AS area,
                'high'::text AS priority,
                'open'::text AS status,
                'Operacion bloqueada para despacho'::text AS title,
                COALESCE(o.reference_code, o.client_display_name, o.id::text) AS subtitle,
                NULL::date AS due_date,
                'operator'::text AS assigned_role,
                NULL::uuid AS assigned_user_id,
                'operation'::text AS related_entity_type,
                o.id AS related_entity_id,
                ('/operations?operationId=' || o.id::text || '&readiness=blocked') AS route,
                false AS is_overdue,
                o.created_at,
                jsonb_build_object('operation_status', o.status, 'reference', o.reference_code) AS metadata,
                80 AS priority_rank
            FROM op_summary o
            WHERE o.has_dispatch_blocker

            UNION ALL

            SELECT
                ('derived:operation_blocking_incident:' || o.id::text),
                'derived',
                'operation_blocking_incident',
                'operations',
                'critical',
                'open',
                'Operacion con incidencia bloqueante abierta',
                COALESCE(o.reference_code, o.client_display_name, o.id::text),
                NULL::date,
                'operator',
                NULL::uuid,
                'operation',
                o.id,
                ('/operations?operationId=' || o.id::text || '&incidents=blocking'),
                false,
                o.created_at,
                jsonb_build_object('blocking_incident_count', o.blocking_incident_count, 'reference', o.reference_code),
                90
            FROM op_summary o
            WHERE o.blocking_incident_count > 0

            UNION ALL

            SELECT
                ('derived:operation_missing_required_documents:' || o.id::text),
                'derived',
                'operation_missing_required_documents',
                'operations',
                'medium',
                'open',
                'Operacion con documentos requeridos faltantes',
                COALESCE(o.missing_required_count::text || ' documento(s) faltantes', o.reference_code, o.id::text),
                NULL::date,
                'operator',
                NULL::uuid,
                'operation',
                o.id,
                ('/operations?operationId=' || o.id::text || '&documents=docs_missing_required'),
                false,
                o.created_at,
                jsonb_build_object('missing_required_count', o.missing_required_count, 'reference', o.reference_code),
                70
            FROM op_summary o
            WHERE o.missing_required_count > 0

            UNION ALL

            SELECT
                ('derived:operation_delivered_billing_blocked:' || o.id::text),
                'derived',
                'operation_delivered_billing_blocked',
                'operations',
                'critical',
                'open',
                'Operacion entregada con billing bloqueado',
                COALESCE(o.reference_code, o.client_display_name, o.id::text),
                NULL::date,
                'operator',
                NULL::uuid,
                'operation',
                o.id,
                ('/operations?operationId=' || o.id::text || '&billing=blocked'),
                false,
                o.created_at,
                jsonb_build_object('billing_status', o.billing_status, 'reference', o.reference_code),
                100
            FROM op_summary o
            WHERE o.status = 'delivered'
              AND NOT o.is_billing_ready
              AND NOT o.is_billed

            UNION ALL

            SELECT
                ('derived:operation_delivered_admin_close_pending:' || o.id::text),
                'derived',
                'operation_delivered_admin_close_pending',
                'operations',
                'medium',
                'open',
                'Operacion entregada sin cierre administrativo',
                COALESCE(o.reference_code, o.client_display_name, o.id::text),
                NULL::date,
                'operator',
                NULL::uuid,
                'operation',
                o.id,
                ('/operations?operationId=' || o.id::text || '&billing=admin_close'),
                false,
                o.created_at,
                jsonb_build_object('billing_status', o.billing_status, 'reference', o.reference_code),
                60
            FROM op_summary o
            WHERE o.status = 'delivered'
              AND o.is_billed
              AND o.admin_closed_at IS NULL
        ),
        commercial_items AS (
            SELECT
                ('derived:quote_approved_pending_conversion:' || d.id::text) AS id,
                'derived'::text AS item_source,
                'quote_approved_pending_conversion'::text AS kind,
                'commercial'::text AS area,
                'medium'::text AS priority,
                'open'::text AS status,
                'Cotizacion aprobada pendiente de convertir'::text AS title,
                COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(d.quote_reference, '')), ''), d.title, d.id::text) AS subtitle,
                NULL::date AS due_date,
                'operator'::text AS assigned_role,
                NULL::uuid AS assigned_user_id,
                'commercial_quote'::text AS related_entity_type,
                d.id AS related_entity_id,
                ('/commercial?dealId=' || d.id::text || '&quoteStatus=approved&converted=pending') AS route,
                false AS is_overdue,
                COALESCE(d.approved_at, d.updated_at, d.created_at) AS created_at,
                jsonb_build_object('company', d.company, 'quote_status', d.quote_status) AS metadata,
                55 AS priority_rank
            FROM public.crm_deals d
            WHERE d.tenant_id = p_tenant_id
              AND d.quote_status = 'approved'
              AND d.converted_operation_id IS NULL
        ),
        finance_due_items AS (
            SELECT
                ('derived:finance_invoice_due:' || fi.id::text) AS id,
                'derived'::text AS item_source,
                CASE WHEN fi.direction = 'ap' THEN 'finance_ap_due' ELSE 'finance_ar_due' END AS kind,
                CASE WHEN fi.direction = 'ap' AND fi.provider_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'provider' ELSE 'finance' END AS area,
                CASE
                    WHEN fi.status = 'overdue' OR fi.due_date < current_date THEN 'critical'
                    WHEN fi.due_date <= current_date + 3 THEN 'high'
                    ELSE 'medium'
                END AS priority,
                'open'::text AS status,
                CASE WHEN fi.direction = 'ap' THEN 'AP proveedor vencida o por vencer' ELSE 'AR vencida o por vencer' END AS title,
                COALESCE(fi.reference, fi.counterparty_name, fi.id::text) AS subtitle,
                fi.due_date,
                'finance'::text AS assigned_role,
                NULL::uuid AS assigned_user_id,
                'finance_invoice'::text AS related_entity_type,
                fi.id AS related_entity_id,
                ('/finance?invoiceId=' || fi.id::text) AS route,
                (fi.due_date IS NOT NULL AND fi.due_date < current_date) AS is_overdue,
                fi.created_at,
                jsonb_build_object('direction', fi.direction, 'counterparty', fi.counterparty_name, 'currency', fi.currency, 'amount', fi.amount) AS metadata,
                CASE WHEN fi.status = 'overdue' OR fi.due_date < current_date THEN 95 WHEN fi.due_date <= current_date + 3 THEN 85 ELSE 65 END AS priority_rank
            FROM private.fiscal02_legacy_finance_invoices fi
            WHERE fi.tenant_id = p_tenant_id
              AND fi.status IN ('open', 'overdue')
              AND fi.due_date IS NOT NULL
              AND fi.due_date <= current_date + 7
        ),
        finance_fx_items AS (
            SELECT
                ('derived:finance_usd_missing_fx:' || fi.id::text) AS id,
                'derived'::text AS item_source,
                'finance_usd_missing_fx'::text AS kind,
                'finance'::text AS area,
                'high'::text AS priority,
                'open'::text AS status,
                'Factura USD abierta sin tipo de cambio valido'::text AS title,
                COALESCE(fi.reference, fi.counterparty_name, fi.id::text) AS subtitle,
                fi.due_date,
                'finance'::text AS assigned_role,
                NULL::uuid AS assigned_user_id,
                'finance_invoice'::text AS related_entity_type,
                fi.id AS related_entity_id,
                ('/finance?invoiceId=' || fi.id::text) AS route,
                (fi.due_date IS NOT NULL AND fi.due_date < current_date) AS is_overdue,
                fi.created_at,
                jsonb_build_object('direction', fi.direction, 'currency', fi.currency, 'exchange_rate', fi.exchange_rate, 'exchange_rate_date', fi.exchange_rate_date) AS metadata,
                82 AS priority_rank
            FROM private.fiscal02_legacy_finance_invoices fi
            WHERE fi.tenant_id = p_tenant_id
              AND fi.status IN ('open', 'overdue')
              AND fi.currency = 'USD'
              AND (fi.exchange_rate IS NULL OR fi.exchange_rate <= 0 OR fi.exchange_rate_date IS NULL)
        ),
        payment_complement_items AS (
            SELECT
                ('derived:payment_complement_pending:' || pc.id::text) AS id,
                'derived'::text AS item_source,
                'payment_complement_pending'::text AS kind,
                'billing'::text AS area,
                CASE WHEN pc.status = 'draft' THEN 'medium' ELSE 'high' END AS priority,
                'open'::text AS status,
                'Complemento de pago pendiente'::text AS title,
                COALESCE(fi.reference, pc.bank_reference, pc.id::text) AS subtitle,
                pc.payment_date::date AS due_date,
                'finance'::text AS assigned_role,
                NULL::uuid AS assigned_user_id,
                'payment_complement'::text AS related_entity_type,
                pc.id AS related_entity_id,
                ('/billing?tab=complements&complementId=' || pc.id::text) AS route,
                false AS is_overdue,
                pc.created_at,
                jsonb_build_object('status', pc.status, 'currency', pc.currency, 'amount', pc.amount, 'finance_invoice_id', pc.finance_invoice_id) AS metadata,
                CASE WHEN pc.status = 'draft' THEN 58 ELSE 72 END AS priority_rank
            FROM private.fiscal02_legacy_billing_payment_complements pc
            LEFT JOIN private.fiscal02_legacy_finance_invoices fi ON fi.id = pc.finance_invoice_id
            WHERE pc.tenant_id = p_tenant_id
              AND pc.status IN ('draft', 'ready')
        ),
        credit_note_items AS (
            SELECT
                ('derived:credit_note_pending:' || cn.id::text) AS id,
                'derived'::text AS item_source,
                CASE WHEN cn.note_type = 'provider_credit' THEN 'provider_credit_note_pending' ELSE 'customer_credit_note_pending' END AS kind,
                CASE WHEN cn.note_type = 'provider_credit' THEN 'provider' ELSE 'finance' END AS area,
                'medium'::text AS priority,
                'open'::text AS status,
                CASE WHEN cn.note_type = 'provider_credit' THEN 'Nota proveedor pendiente' ELSE 'Nota de credito pendiente' END AS title,
                COALESCE(cn.folio, cn.provider_note_reference, fi.reference, cn.id::text) AS subtitle,
                cn.issue_date AS due_date,
                'finance'::text AS assigned_role,
                NULL::uuid AS assigned_user_id,
                CASE WHEN cn.note_type = 'provider_credit' THEN 'provider_document' ELSE 'credit_note' END AS related_entity_type,
                cn.id AS related_entity_id,
                ('/billing?tab=credit-notes&creditNoteId=' || cn.id::text) AS route,
                false AS is_overdue,
                cn.created_at,
                jsonb_build_object('note_type', cn.note_type, 'currency', cn.currency, 'total', cn.total, 'finance_invoice_id', cn.finance_invoice_id) AS metadata,
                56 AS priority_rank
            FROM private.fiscal02_legacy_billing_credit_notes cn
            LEFT JOIN private.fiscal02_legacy_finance_invoices fi ON fi.id = cn.finance_invoice_id
            WHERE cn.tenant_id = p_tenant_id
              AND cn.status = 'draft'
        ),
        document_finance_rows AS (
            SELECT *
            FROM jsonb_to_recordset(
                CASE WHEN v_role IN ('admin', 'finance') THEN public.rpc_list_document_finance_pending(p_tenant_id) ELSE '[]'::jsonb END
            ) AS x(
                pending_type text,
                entity_id uuid,
                reference text,
                counterparty text,
                amount numeric,
                currency text,
                status text,
                created_at timestamptz
            )
        ),
        document_finance_items AS (
            SELECT
                ('derived:document_finance_pending:' || r.entity_id::text) AS id,
                'derived'::text AS item_source,
                ('document_pending_' || r.pending_type)::text AS kind,
                'documents'::text AS area,
                'medium'::text AS priority,
                'open'::text AS status,
                'Documento financiero pendiente de generar'::text AS title,
                COALESCE(r.reference, r.counterparty, r.entity_id::text) AS subtitle,
                NULL::date AS due_date,
                'finance'::text AS assigned_role,
                NULL::uuid AS assigned_user_id,
                r.pending_type AS related_entity_type,
                r.entity_id AS related_entity_id,
                ('/documents?templateType=' || r.pending_type || '&entityId=' || r.entity_id::text) AS route,
                false AS is_overdue,
                r.created_at,
                jsonb_build_object('counterparty', r.counterparty, 'amount', r.amount, 'currency', r.currency, 'source_status', r.status) AS metadata,
                54 AS priority_rank
            FROM document_finance_rows r
        ),
        fiscal_rows AS (
            SELECT *
            FROM jsonb_to_recordset(
                CASE WHEN v_role IN ('admin', 'finance') THEN public.rpc_list_fiscal_document_workbench(p_tenant_id, jsonb_build_object('limit', 150)) ELSE '[]'::jsonb END
            ) AS x(
                billing_document_id uuid,
                reference text,
                document_type text,
                document_direction text,
                status text,
                customer_name text,
                provider_name text,
                currency text,
                total numeric,
                total_mxn numeric,
                validation_blockers jsonb,
                validation_warnings jsonb,
                outbox_id uuid,
                outbox_status text,
                outbox_last_error text,
                outbox_attempt_count integer,
                outbox_next_attempt_at timestamptz,
                outbox_last_attempt_at timestamptz,
                queued_at timestamptz,
                stamped_at timestamptz,
                has_fiscal_xml boolean,
                has_fiscal_pdf boolean,
                file_count integer,
                created_at timestamptz,
                updated_at timestamptz
            )
        ),
        fiscal_items AS (
            SELECT
                ('derived:fiscal_workbench_attention:' || r.billing_document_id::text) AS id,
                'derived'::text AS item_source,
                CASE
                    WHEN COALESCE(jsonb_array_length(r.validation_blockers), 0) > 0 THEN 'fiscal_workbench_blocked'
                    WHEN r.outbox_status = 'failed' OR r.status = 'api_error' THEN 'fiscal_workbench_retryable'
                    WHEN NOT COALESCE(r.has_fiscal_xml, false) OR NOT COALESCE(r.has_fiscal_pdf, false) THEN 'fiscal_files_missing'
                    ELSE 'fiscal_workbench_attention'
                END AS kind,
                'billing'::text AS area,
                CASE
                    WHEN COALESCE(jsonb_array_length(r.validation_blockers), 0) > 0 THEN 'critical'
                    WHEN r.outbox_status = 'failed' OR r.status = 'api_error' THEN 'high'
                    ELSE 'medium'
                END AS priority,
                'open'::text AS status,
                CASE
                    WHEN COALESCE(jsonb_array_length(r.validation_blockers), 0) > 0 THEN 'Documento fiscal con bloqueo'
                    WHEN r.outbox_status = 'failed' OR r.status = 'api_error' THEN 'Documento fiscal fallido o reintentable'
                    WHEN NOT COALESCE(r.has_fiscal_xml, false) OR NOT COALESCE(r.has_fiscal_pdf, false) THEN 'XML/PDF fiscal faltante'
                    ELSE 'Workbench fiscal requiere revision'
                END AS title,
                COALESCE(r.reference, r.customer_name, r.provider_name, r.billing_document_id::text) AS subtitle,
                NULL::date AS due_date,
                'finance'::text AS assigned_role,
                NULL::uuid AS assigned_user_id,
                'billing_document'::text AS related_entity_type,
                r.billing_document_id AS related_entity_id,
                ('/billing?tab=fiscal-workbench&billingDocumentId=' || r.billing_document_id::text) AS route,
                false AS is_overdue,
                COALESCE(r.updated_at, r.created_at) AS created_at,
                jsonb_build_object(
                    'document_type', r.document_type,
                    'source_status', r.status,
                    'outbox_status', r.outbox_status,
                    'blockers', COALESCE(r.validation_blockers, '[]'::jsonb),
                    'warnings', COALESCE(r.validation_warnings, '[]'::jsonb),
                    'has_fiscal_xml', r.has_fiscal_xml,
                    'has_fiscal_pdf', r.has_fiscal_pdf
                ) AS metadata,
                CASE
                    WHEN COALESCE(jsonb_array_length(r.validation_blockers), 0) > 0 THEN 88
                    WHEN r.outbox_status = 'failed' OR r.status = 'api_error' THEN 78
                    ELSE 52
                END AS priority_rank
            FROM fiscal_rows r
            WHERE COALESCE(jsonb_array_length(r.validation_blockers), 0) > 0
               OR r.outbox_status = 'failed'
               OR r.status = 'api_error'
               OR (r.status = 'stamped' AND (NOT COALESCE(r.has_fiscal_xml, false) OR NOT COALESCE(r.has_fiscal_pdf, false)))
        ),
        payroll_period_items AS (
            SELECT
                ('derived:payroll_approved_pending_payment:' || pp.id::text) AS id,
                'derived'::text AS item_source,
                'payroll_approved_pending_payment'::text AS kind,
                'payroll'::text AS area,
                'high'::text AS priority,
                'open'::text AS status,
                'Periodo de nomina aprobado pendiente de pago'::text AS title,
                pp.name AS subtitle,
                pp.period_end AS due_date,
                'finance'::text AS assigned_role,
                NULL::uuid AS assigned_user_id,
                'payroll_period'::text AS related_entity_type,
                pp.id AS related_entity_id,
                ('/payroll?periodId=' || pp.id::text) AS route,
                (pp.period_end < current_date) AS is_overdue,
                pp.created_at,
                jsonb_build_object('net_total', pp.net_total, 'finance_invoice_id', pp.finance_invoice_id) AS metadata,
                74 AS priority_rank
            FROM public.payroll_periods pp
            LEFT JOIN private.fiscal02_legacy_finance_invoices fi ON fi.id = pp.finance_invoice_id
            WHERE pp.tenant_id = p_tenant_id
              AND pp.status = 'approved'
              AND (pp.finance_invoice_id IS NULL OR COALESCE(fi.status, 'open') <> 'paid')
        ),
        payroll_receipt_items AS (
            SELECT
                ('derived:payroll_receipts_pending_issue:' || pp.id::text) AS id,
                'derived'::text AS item_source,
                'payroll_receipts_pending_issue'::text AS kind,
                'payroll'::text AS area,
                'medium'::text AS priority,
                'open'::text AS status,
                'Recibos internos de nomina pendientes de emitir'::text AS title,
                pp.name AS subtitle,
                pp.period_end AS due_date,
                'finance'::text AS assigned_role,
                NULL::uuid AS assigned_user_id,
                'payroll_period'::text AS related_entity_type,
                pp.id AS related_entity_id,
                ('/payroll?tab=receipts&periodId=' || pp.id::text) AS route,
                (pp.period_end < current_date) AS is_overdue,
                pp.created_at,
                jsonb_build_object(
                    'entry_count', count(pe.id),
                    'issued_receipt_count', count(pr.id) FILTER (WHERE pr.status = 'issued')
                ) AS metadata,
                53 AS priority_rank
            FROM public.payroll_periods pp
            JOIN public.payroll_entries pe ON pe.period_id = pp.id
            LEFT JOIN public.payroll_receipts pr ON pr.entry_id = pe.id AND pr.status = 'issued'
            WHERE pp.tenant_id = p_tenant_id
              AND pp.status IN ('approved', 'paid')
            GROUP BY pp.id, pp.name, pp.period_end, pp.created_at
            HAVING count(pe.id) > count(pr.id) FILTER (WHERE pr.status = 'issued')
        ),
        manual_items AS (
            SELECT
                wi.id::text AS id,
                'manual'::text AS item_source,
                'manual_work_item'::text AS kind,
                wi.area,
                wi.priority,
                wi.status,
                wi.title,
                wi.description AS subtitle,
                wi.due_date,
                wi.assigned_role,
                wi.assigned_user_id,
                wi.related_entity_type,
                wi.related_entity_id,
                wi.route,
                (wi.due_date IS NOT NULL AND wi.due_date < current_date AND wi.status IN ('open', 'in_progress')) AS is_overdue,
                wi.created_at,
                wi.metadata || jsonb_build_object('manual_item_id', wi.id, 'resolved_at', wi.resolved_at, 'resolved_by', wi.resolved_by) AS metadata,
                CASE wi.priority WHEN 'critical' THEN 100 WHEN 'high' THEN 80 WHEN 'medium' THEN 50 ELSE 20 END AS priority_rank
            FROM public.daily_work_items wi
            WHERE wi.tenant_id = p_tenant_id
        ),
        unified AS (
            SELECT * FROM operation_items
            UNION ALL SELECT * FROM commercial_items
            UNION ALL SELECT * FROM finance_due_items
            UNION ALL SELECT * FROM finance_fx_items
            UNION ALL SELECT * FROM payment_complement_items
            UNION ALL SELECT * FROM credit_note_items
            UNION ALL SELECT * FROM document_finance_items
            UNION ALL SELECT * FROM fiscal_items
            UNION ALL SELECT * FROM payroll_period_items
            UNION ALL SELECT * FROM payroll_receipt_items
            UNION ALL SELECT * FROM manual_items
        ),
        filtered AS (
            SELECT *
            FROM unified u
            WHERE public.tanda6_can_view_area(p_tenant_id, u.area)
              AND (v_filter_area IS NULL OR u.area = v_filter_area)
              AND (v_filter_priority IS NULL OR u.priority = v_filter_priority)
              AND (v_filter_status IS NULL OR u.status = v_filter_status)
              AND (v_filter_source IS NULL OR u.item_source = v_filter_source)
              AND (v_filter_assigned_role IS NULL OR u.assigned_role = v_filter_assigned_role)
              AND (v_filter_overdue IS NULL OR u.is_overdue = v_filter_overdue)
        )
        SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(page_rows)), '[]'::jsonb)
        FROM (
            SELECT
                id,
                item_source,
                kind,
                area,
                priority,
                status,
                title,
                subtitle,
                due_date,
                assigned_role,
                assigned_user_id,
                related_entity_type,
                related_entity_id,
                route,
                is_overdue,
                created_at,
                metadata,
                priority_rank
            FROM filtered
            ORDER BY priority_rank DESC, is_overdue DESC, due_date ASC NULLS LAST, created_at DESC NULLS LAST
            LIMIT v_limit
        ) page_rows
    );
END;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_list_document_finance_pending(p_tenant_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF NOT public.tanda4_user_has_role(p_tenant_id, ARRAY['admin', 'finance']) THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'unauthorized');
    END IF;

    RETURN (
        WITH pending AS (
            SELECT
                'payment_complement'::text AS pending_type,
                pc.id AS entity_id,
                COALESCE(fi.reference, pc.id::text) AS reference,
                COALESCE(fi.counterparty_name, 'Sin contraparte') AS counterparty,
                pc.amount AS amount,
                pc.currency AS currency,
                pc.status AS status,
                pc.created_at AS created_at
            FROM private.fiscal02_legacy_billing_payment_complements pc
            LEFT JOIN private.fiscal02_legacy_finance_invoices fi ON fi.id = pc.finance_invoice_id
            WHERE pc.tenant_id = p_tenant_id
              AND NOT EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1 FROM public.generated_documents gd
                  WHERE gd.tenant_id = p_tenant_id
                    AND gd.entity_type = 'payment_complement'
                    AND gd.entity_id = pc.id
                    AND gd.status <> 'cancelled'
              )
            UNION ALL
            SELECT
                CASE WHEN cn.note_type = 'provider_credit' THEN 'provider_document' ELSE 'credit_note' END AS pending_type,
                cn.id AS entity_id,
                COALESCE(cn.folio, cn.provider_note_reference, cn.id::text) AS reference,
                COALESCE(cust.display_name, lp.display_name, fi.counterparty_name, 'Sin contraparte') AS counterparty,
                cn.total AS amount,
                cn.currency AS currency,
                cn.status AS status,
                cn.created_at AS created_at
            FROM private.fiscal02_legacy_billing_credit_notes cn
            LEFT JOIN public.customers cust ON cust.id = cn.customer_id
            LEFT JOIN public.logistics_providers lp ON lp.id = cn.provider_id
            LEFT JOIN private.fiscal02_legacy_finance_invoices fi ON fi.id = cn.finance_invoice_id
            WHERE cn.tenant_id = p_tenant_id
              AND NOT EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1 FROM public.generated_documents gd
                  WHERE gd.tenant_id = p_tenant_id
                    AND gd.entity_type = CASE WHEN cn.note_type = 'provider_credit' THEN 'provider_document' ELSE 'credit_note' END
                    AND gd.entity_id = cn.id
                    AND gd.status <> 'cancelled'
              )
        )
        SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p) ORDER BY p.created_at DESC), '[]'::jsonb)
        FROM pending p
    );
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_list_document_tax_summary(p_tenant_id uuid, p_date_from date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_date_to date DEFAULT NULL::date)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF NOT public.tanda4_user_has_role(p_tenant_id, ARRAY['admin', 'finance']) THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'unauthorized');
    END IF;

    RETURN (
        WITH rows AS (
            SELECT
                'billing_document'::text AS source_type,
                d.document_type,
                d.document_direction,
                d.currency,
                d.subtotal,
                d.transferred_taxes_total AS iva,
                d.withheld_taxes_total AS withheld,
                d.total,
                d.subtotal_mxn,
                d.transferred_taxes_total_mxn AS iva_mxn,
                d.total_mxn,
                d.created_at::date AS document_date
            FROM private.fiscal02_legacy_billing_documents d
            WHERE d.tenant_id = p_tenant_id
              AND (p_date_from IS NULL OR d.created_at::date >= p_date_from)
              AND (p_date_to IS NULL OR d.created_at::date <= p_date_to)
            UNION ALL
            SELECT
                'credit_note'::text AS source_type,
                cn.note_type AS document_type,
                CASE WHEN cn.note_type = 'provider_credit' THEN 'egreso' ELSE 'ingreso' END AS document_direction,
                cn.currency,
                cn.subtotal,
                cn.iva,
                0::numeric AS withheld,
                cn.total,
                NULL::numeric AS subtotal_mxn,
                NULL::numeric AS iva_mxn,
                cn.total_mxn,
                cn.issue_date AS document_date
            FROM private.fiscal02_legacy_billing_credit_notes cn
            WHERE cn.tenant_id = p_tenant_id
              AND (p_date_from IS NULL OR cn.issue_date >= p_date_from)
              AND (p_date_to IS NULL OR cn.issue_date <= p_date_to)
        )
        SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(
            jsonb_build_object(
                'source_type', source_type,
                'document_type', document_type,
                'document_direction', document_direction,
                'currency', currency,
                'document_count', document_count,
                'subtotal', subtotal,
                'iva', iva,
                'withheld', withheld,
                'total', total,
                'subtotal_mxn', subtotal_mxn,
                'iva_mxn', iva_mxn,
                'total_mxn', total_mxn
            ) ORDER BY source_type, document_type
        ), '[]'::jsonb)
        FROM (
            SELECT
                source_type,
                document_type,
                document_direction,
                currency,
                count(*) AS document_count,
                round(sum(COALESCE(subtotal, 0)), 2) AS subtotal,
                round(sum(COALESCE(iva, 0)), 2) AS iva,
                round(sum(COALESCE(withheld, 0)), 2) AS withheld,
                round(sum(COALESCE(total, 0)), 2) AS total,
                round(sum(COALESCE(subtotal_mxn, subtotal, 0)), 2) AS subtotal_mxn,
                round(sum(COALESCE(iva_mxn, iva, 0)), 2) AS iva_mxn,
                round(sum(COALESCE(total_mxn, total, 0)), 2) AS total_mxn
            FROM rows
            GROUP BY source_type, document_type, document_direction, currency
        ) grouped
    );
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_list_internal_notifications(p_tenant_id uuid, p_filters jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_role text := public.tanda6_user_role(p_tenant_id);
    v_user_id uuid := auth.uid();
    v_items jsonb;
    v_filter_status text := NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(p_filters->>'status', '')), '');
    v_limit integer := LEAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF(p_filters->>'limit', '')::integer, 20), 1), 50);
BEGIN
    IF v_user_id IS NULL OR v_role IS NULL THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'unauthorized');
    END IF;

    PERFORM public.tanda8_seed_default_notification_rules(p_tenant_id);

    v_items := public.rpc_list_daily_control_items(
        p_tenant_id,
        jsonb_build_object('status', 'open', 'limit', 100)
    );

    IF jsonb_typeof(v_items) = 'object' AND v_items ? 'error' THEN
        RETURN v_items;
    END IF;

    WITH parsed AS (
        SELECT item
        FROM jsonb_array_elements(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(v_items) = 'array' THEN v_items ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) AS source(item)
    ),
    candidates AS (
        SELECT
            'daily_control:' || (item->>'id') AS fingerprint,
            public.tanda8_notification_trigger_type(
                item->>'area',
                item->>'kind',
                item->>'priority',
                COALESCE((item->>'is_overdue')::boolean, false)
            ) AS trigger_type,
            item->>'area' AS area,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(item->>'priority', ''), 'medium') AS priority,
            public.tanda8_notification_icon(item->>'area', item->>'priority') AS icon,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(item->>'title', ''), 'Pendiente diario') AS title,
            trim(BOTH ' ' FROM COALESCE(NULLIF(item->>'subtitle', ''), 'Revisar en la bandeja de pendientes.')) AS body,
            NULLIF(item->>'route', '') AS route,
            NULLIF(item->>'related_entity_type', '') AS related_entity_type,
            NULLIF(item->>'related_entity_id', '') AS related_entity_id,
            item AS metadata
        FROM parsed
        WHERE COALESCE(NULLIF(item->>'status', ''), 'open') = 'open'
          AND (
              COALESCE(item->>'priority', '') IN ('critical', 'high')
              OR COALESCE((item->>'is_overdue')::boolean, false)
          )
    ),
    permitted AS (
        SELECT c.*
        FROM candidates c
        WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM public.internal_notification_rules r
            WHERE r.tenant_id = p_tenant_id
              AND r.target_role = v_role
              AND r.trigger_type = c.trigger_type
              AND r.is_enabled = true
              AND (r.area IS NULL OR r.area = c.area)
        )
    )
    INSERT INTO public.internal_notifications (
        tenant_id,
        user_id,
        fingerprint,
        trigger_type,
        area,
        priority,
        icon,
        title,
        body,
        route,
        related_entity_type,
        related_entity_id,
        metadata,
        last_seen_at
    )
    SELECT
        p_tenant_id,
        v_user_id,
        fingerprint,
        trigger_type,
        area,
        priority,
        icon,
        title,
        body,
        route,
        related_entity_type,
        related_entity_id,
        metadata,
        now()
    FROM permitted
    ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, user_id, fingerprint)
    DO UPDATE SET
        trigger_type = EXCLUDED.trigger_type,
        area = EXCLUDED.area,
        priority = EXCLUDED.priority,
        icon = EXCLUDED.icon,
        title = EXCLUDED.title,
        body = EXCLUDED.body,
        route = EXCLUDED.route,
        related_entity_type = EXCLUDED.related_entity_type,
        related_entity_id = EXCLUDED.related_entity_id,
        metadata = EXCLUDED.metadata,
        last_seen_at = now();

    RETURN (
        SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(n) ORDER BY n.last_seen_at DESC), '[]'::jsonb)
        FROM (
            SELECT *
            FROM public.internal_notifications n
            WHERE n.tenant_id = p_tenant_id
              AND n.user_id = v_user_id
              AND n.status <> 'dismissed'
              AND (v_filter_status IS NULL OR n.status = v_filter_status)
            ORDER BY n.last_seen_at DESC
            LIMIT v_limit
        ) n
    );
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_list_operation_billing(p_tenant_id uuid, p_filters jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_state_filter text := COALESCE(p_filters->>'state', 'all');
BEGIN
    IF NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.memberships m
        WHERE m.user_id = auth.uid()
          AND m.tenant_id = p_tenant_id
    ) THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'unauthorized');
    END IF;

    RETURN (
        WITH rows AS (
            SELECT
                o.id AS operation_id,
                o.reference_code AS operation_reference_code,
                o.client_display_name AS operation_client_display_name,
                o.status AS operation_status,
                public.rpc_get_operation_billing_summary(o.id) AS billing_summary
            FROM public.operations o
            WHERE o.tenant_id = p_tenant_id
        )
        SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(
            jsonb_build_object(
                'operation_id', r.operation_id,
                'operation_reference_code', r.operation_reference_code,
                'operation_client_display_name', r.operation_client_display_name,
                'operation_status', r.operation_status,
                'billing_summary', r.billing_summary
            )
            ORDER BY r.operation_reference_code ASC
        ), '[]'::jsonb)
        FROM rows r
        WHERE (
            v_state_filter = 'all'
            OR (v_state_filter = 'ready' AND COALESCE((r.billing_summary->>'is_billing_ready')::boolean, false))
            OR (v_state_filter = 'blocked' AND r.operation_status = 'delivered' AND NOT COALESCE((r.billing_summary->>'is_billing_ready')::boolean, false) AND NOT COALESCE((r.billing_summary->>'is_billed')::boolean, false))
            OR (v_state_filter = 'billed' AND COALESCE((r.billing_summary->>'is_billed')::boolean, false))
            OR (v_state_filter = 'admin_closed' AND COALESCE((r.billing_summary->>'is_admin_closed')::boolean, false))
            OR (v_state_filter = 'voided' AND COALESCE(r.billing_summary->>'status', '') = 'voided')
        )
    );
END;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_list_payroll_periods(p_tenant_id uuid, p_status text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF NOT public.tanda3_user_has_role(p_tenant_id) THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'unauthorized');
    END IF;

    RETURN (
        SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(
            jsonb_build_object(
                'id', p.id,
                'tenant_id', p.tenant_id,
                'name', p.name,
                'frequency', p.frequency,
                'period_start', p.period_start,
                'period_end', p.period_end,
                'status', p.status,
                'gross_total', p.gross_total,
                'deductions_total', p.deductions_total,
                'manual_tax_total', p.manual_tax_total,
                'net_total', p.net_total,
                'finance_invoice_id', p.finance_invoice_id,
                'finance_invoice_status', fi.status,
                'approved_at', p.approved_at,
                'paid_at', p.paid_at,
                'created_at', p.created_at,
                'updated_at', p.updated_at,
                'employee_count', COALESCE(entries.employee_count, 0),
                'receipt_count', COALESCE(receipts.receipt_count, 0)
            ) ORDER BY p.period_start DESC
        ), '[]'::jsonb)
        FROM public.payroll_periods p
        LEFT JOIN private.fiscal02_legacy_finance_invoices fi ON fi.id = p.finance_invoice_id
        LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT count(*)::int AS employee_count
            FROM public.payroll_entries pe
            WHERE pe.period_id = p.id
        ) entries ON true
        LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT count(*)::int AS receipt_count
            FROM public.payroll_receipts pr
            WHERE pr.period_id = p.id AND pr.status = 'issued'
        ) receipts ON true
        WHERE p.tenant_id = p_tenant_id
          AND (p_status IS NULL OR p.status = p_status)
    );
END;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_list_route_points(p_operation_id uuid, p_start timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone, p_end timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone, p_limit integer DEFAULT 2000, p_max_display integer DEFAULT 500)
 RETURNS TABLE(lat double precision, lng double precision, recorded_at timestamp with time zone, accuracy_m double precision, source text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_tenant_id uuid;
    v_total     int;
    v_step      int;
BEGIN
    SELECT tenant_id INTO v_tenant_id
    FROM operations WHERE id = p_operation_id;

    IF v_tenant_id IS NULL THEN RETURN; END IF;

    IF NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM memberships m
        WHERE m.user_id = auth.uid() AND m.tenant_id = v_tenant_id
    ) THEN RETURN; END IF;

    RETURN QUERY
    WITH raw AS (
        SELECT rp.lat, rp.lng, rp.recorded_at, rp.accuracy_m, rp.source
        FROM tracking_route_points rp
        WHERE rp.operation_id = p_operation_id
          AND (p_start IS NULL OR rp.recorded_at >= p_start)
          AND (p_end IS NULL OR rp.recorded_at <= p_end)
        ORDER BY rp.recorded_at ASC
        LIMIT LEAST(p_limit, 2000)
    ),
    -- Compute speed from previous point using LAG window function
    with_speed AS (
        SELECT
            r.lat, r.lng, r.recorded_at, r.accuracy_m, r.source,
            CASE
                WHEN LAG(r.recorded_at) OVER (ORDER BY r.recorded_at ASC) IS NULL THEN 0
                WHEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (r.recorded_at - LAG(r.recorded_at) OVER (ORDER BY r.recorded_at ASC))) < 1 THEN 0
                ELSE (
                    haversine_m(
                        LAG(r.lat) OVER (ORDER BY r.recorded_at ASC),
                        LAG(r.lng) OVER (ORDER BY r.recorded_at ASC),
                        r.lat, r.lng
                    ) / 1000.0
                ) / (
                    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (r.recorded_at - LAG(r.recorded_at) OVER (ORDER BY r.recorded_at ASC))) / 3600.0
                )
            END AS speed_kmh,
            row_number() OVER (ORDER BY r.recorded_at ASC) AS rn,
            count(*) OVER () AS total_count
        FROM raw r
    ),
    -- Outlier filter: discard points where speed > 200 km/h
    filtered AS (
        SELECT ws.lat, ws.lng, ws.recorded_at, ws.accuracy_m, ws.source,
               row_number() OVER (ORDER BY ws.recorded_at ASC) AS rn,
               count(*) OVER () AS filtered_count
        FROM with_speed ws
        WHERE ws.speed_kmh <= 200 OR ws.rn = 1  -- always keep first point
    ),
    -- Downsampling: if too many points, pick every Nth + first + last
    sampled AS (
        SELECT f.lat, f.lng, f.recorded_at, f.accuracy_m, f.source
        FROM filtered f
        WHERE f.filtered_count <= p_max_display
           OR f.rn = 1
           OR f.rn = f.filtered_count
           OR (f.rn % GREATEST(1, (f.filtered_count / p_max_display))) = 0
        ORDER BY f.recorded_at ASC
    )
    SELECT s.lat, s.lng, s.recorded_at, s.accuracy_m, s.source
    FROM sampled s;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_register_billing_api_result(p_outbox_id uuid, p_result jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_outbox public.billing_api_outbox%rowtype;
    v_document public.billing_documents%rowtype;
    v_issuer public.billing_document_parties%rowtype;
    v_receiver public.billing_document_parties%rowtype;
    v_status text := COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(p_result->>'status'), ''), '');
    v_success boolean := COALESCE(NULLIF(p_result->>'success', '')::boolean, false);
    v_cfdi_uuid text := NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(p_result->>'uuid', '')), '');
    v_cfdi_id uuid;
BEGIN
    SELECT *
    INTO v_outbox
    FROM public.billing_api_outbox
    WHERE id = p_outbox_id;

    IF v_outbox.id IS NULL THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'outbox_not_found');
    END IF;

    SELECT *
    INTO v_document
    FROM private.fiscal02_legacy_billing_documents
    WHERE id = v_outbox.document_id;

    IF v_document.id IS NULL THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'document_not_found');
    END IF;

    IF auth.role() <> 'service_role'
       AND NOT public.billing_user_has_tenant(v_document.tenant_id, ARRAY['admin', 'operator']) THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'unauthorized');
    END IF;

    INSERT INTO public.billing_api_attempts (
        tenant_id,
        outbox_id,
        document_id,
        attempt_number,
        provider_key,
        request_payload,
        response_status,
        response_payload,
        error_message
    ) VALUES (
        v_outbox.tenant_id,
        v_outbox.id,
        v_outbox.document_id,
        v_outbox.attempt_count + 1,
        v_outbox.provider_key,
        v_outbox.request_payload,
        NULLIF(p_result->>'response_status', '')::int,
        p_result,
        p_result->>'error'
    );

    IF v_success = true OR v_status IN ('succeeded', 'stamped', 'timbrado') THEN
        UPDATE public.billing_api_outbox
        SET status = 'succeeded',
            response_payload = p_result,
            attempt_count = attempt_count + 1,
            last_attempt_at = now(),
            last_error = NULL,
            updated_at = now()
        WHERE id = p_outbox_id;

        SELECT *
        INTO v_issuer
        FROM public.billing_document_parties
        WHERE document_id = v_document.id
          AND role = 'issuer';

        SELECT *
        INTO v_receiver
        FROM public.billing_document_parties
        WHERE document_id = v_document.id
          AND role = 'receiver';

        IF v_cfdi_uuid IS NOT NULL THEN
            INSERT INTO public.billing_cfdis (
                tenant_id,
                uuid,
                serie,
                folio,
                rfc_emisor,
                rfc_receptor,
                receptor_name,
                subtotal,
                total,
                currency,
                status,
                has_carta_porte,
                has_complemento_pago,
                issued_at,
                pac_provider,
                notes
            ) VALUES (
                v_document.tenant_id,
                v_cfdi_uuid,
                v_document.serie,
                v_document.folio,
                COALESCE(v_issuer.rfc, ''),
                COALESCE(v_receiver.rfc, ''),
                v_receiver.legal_name,
                v_document.subtotal,
                v_document.total,
                v_document.currency,
                'timbrado',
                false,
                v_document.document_type = 'complemento_pago',
                COALESCE(NULLIF(p_result->>'issued_at', '')::timestamptz, now()),
                v_outbox.provider_key,
                v_document.notes
            )
            ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, uuid) DO UPDATE SET
                serie = EXCLUDED.serie,
                folio = EXCLUDED.folio,
                rfc_emisor = EXCLUDED.rfc_emisor,
                rfc_receptor = EXCLUDED.rfc_receptor,
                receptor_name = EXCLUDED.receptor_name,
                subtotal = EXCLUDED.subtotal,
                total = EXCLUDED.total,
                currency = EXCLUDED.currency,
                status = 'timbrado',
                issued_at = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.issued_at, public.billing_cfdis.issued_at),
                pac_provider = EXCLUDED.pac_provider,
                notes = EXCLUDED.notes,
                updated_at = now()
            RETURNING id INTO v_cfdi_id;
        END IF;

        UPDATE public.billing_documents
        SET status = 'stamped',
            fiscal_uuid = COALESCE(v_cfdi_uuid, fiscal_uuid),
            linked_cfdi_id = COALESCE(v_cfdi_id, linked_cfdi_id),
            stamped_at = now(),
            updated_at = now()
        WHERE id = v_document.id;

        IF v_cfdi_id IS NOT NULL AND v_document.operation_id IS NOT NULL THEN
            UPDATE public.operation_billing
            SET linked_cfdi_id = v_cfdi_id,
                billing_reference = COALESCE(NULLIF(concat(COALESCE(v_document.serie, ''), COALESCE(v_document.folio, '')), ''), billing_reference),
                updated_at = now()
            WHERE operation_id = v_document.operation_id
              AND tenant_id = v_document.tenant_id;
        END IF;

        RETURN jsonb_build_object(
            'success', true,
            'cfdi_id', v_cfdi_id,
            'document', public.billing_fiscal_document_json(v_document.id)
        );
    END IF;

    UPDATE public.billing_api_outbox
    SET status = 'failed',
        response_payload = p_result,
        attempt_count = attempt_count + 1,
        last_attempt_at = now(),
        last_error = COALESCE(p_result->>'error', p_result->>'message', 'api_error'),
        updated_at = now()
    WHERE id = p_outbox_id;

    UPDATE public.billing_documents
    SET status = 'api_error',
        updated_at = now()
    WHERE id = v_document.id;

    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
        'success', false,
        'error', COALESCE(p_result->>'error', p_result->>'message', 'api_error'),
        'document', public.billing_fiscal_document_json(v_document.id)
    );
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', SQLERRM);
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_tracking_healthcheck(p_tenant_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM memberships m
        WHERE m.user_id = auth.uid()
          AND m.tenant_id = p_tenant_id
    ) THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'unauthorized');
    END IF;

    RETURN (
        WITH op_base AS (
            SELECT
                o.id AS operation_id,
                o.reference_code,
                o.client_display_name,
                o.route_summary,
                o.status AS operation_status,
                (
                    SELECT max(e.server_timestamp)
                    FROM tracking_events e
                    WHERE e.operation_id = o.id
                ) AS last_event_at,
                (
                    SELECT max(rp.recorded_at)
                    FROM tracking_route_points rp
                    WHERE rp.operation_id = o.id
                ) AS last_signal_at,
                (
                    SELECT dt.state
                    FROM tracking_tokens dt
                    WHERE dt.operation_id = o.id
                      AND dt.scope = 'public:read'
                    ORDER BY dt.created_at DESC
                    LIMIT 1
                ) AS public_token_state,
                (
                    SELECT dt.state
                    FROM tracking_tokens dt
                    WHERE dt.operation_id = o.id
                      AND dt.scope = 'driver:write'
                    ORDER BY dt.created_at DESC
                    LIMIT 1
                ) AS driver_token_state,
                (
                    SELECT dt.last_used_at
                    FROM tracking_tokens dt
                    WHERE dt.operation_id = o.id
                      AND dt.scope = 'driver:write'
                    ORDER BY dt.created_at DESC
                    LIMIT 1
                ) AS driver_last_used_at,
                EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM tracking_route_points rp
                    WHERE rp.operation_id = o.id
                ) AS has_route_points,
                EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM tracking_events e
                    WHERE e.operation_id = o.id
                      AND e.event_type != 'incident'
                ) AS has_events,
                (
                    SELECT e.event_type
                    FROM tracking_events e
                    WHERE e.operation_id = o.id
                      AND e.event_type != 'incident'
                    ORDER BY e.server_timestamp DESC
                    LIMIT 1
                ) AS last_event_type
            FROM operations o
            WHERE o.tenant_id = p_tenant_id
        )
        SELECT COALESCE(
            jsonb_agg(
                jsonb_build_object(
                    'operation_id', ob.operation_id,
                    'reference_code', ob.reference_code,
                    'client_display_name', ob.client_display_name,
                    'route_summary', ob.route_summary,
                    'operation_status', ob.operation_status,
                    'last_event_at', CASE
                        WHEN ob.last_event_at IS NOT NULL THEN to_char(ob.last_event_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"')
                        ELSE NULL
                    END,
                    'last_signal_at', CASE
                        WHEN ob.last_signal_at IS NOT NULL THEN to_char(ob.last_signal_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"')
                        ELSE NULL
                    END,
                    'last_used_at', CASE
                        WHEN ob.driver_last_used_at IS NOT NULL THEN to_char(ob.driver_last_used_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"')
                        ELSE NULL
                    END,
                    'public_token_state', ob.public_token_state,
                    'driver_token_state', ob.driver_token_state,
                    'flags', jsonb_build_object(
                        'gps_recent_without_event', ob.last_signal_at IS NOT NULL
                            AND (ob.last_event_at IS NULL OR ob.last_signal_at > ob.last_event_at + interval '5 minutes'),
                        'event_recent_status_mismatch', ob.last_event_type IS NOT NULL
                            AND (
                                (ob.last_event_type = 'departure' AND ob.operation_status <> 'in_transit') OR
                                (ob.last_event_type = 'in_transit' AND ob.operation_status <> 'in_transit') OR
                                (ob.last_event_type = 'arrival' AND ob.operation_status <> 'at_destination') OR
                                (ob.last_event_type = 'delivered' AND ob.operation_status <> 'delivered')
                            ),
                        'public_without_driver_token', ob.public_token_state IS NOT NULL AND ob.driver_token_state IS NULL,
                        'driver_token_idle', ob.driver_last_used_at IS NOT NULL
                            AND ob.driver_last_used_at < now() - interval '2 hours',
                        'route_points_without_public_location', ob.has_route_points
                            AND ob.operation_status NOT IN ('delivered', 'closed', 'cancelled')
                            AND COALESCE(ob.public_token_state, 'missing') NOT IN ('active', 'soft_expired')
                    ),
                    'health_state', CASE
                        WHEN ob.public_token_state IN ('revoked', 'rotated', 'hard_expired')
                          OR ob.driver_token_state IN ('revoked', 'rotated', 'hard_expired') THEN 'token_issue'
                        WHEN ob.last_signal_at IS NULL AND ob.last_event_at IS NULL THEN 'no_gps'
                        WHEN COALESCE(ob.last_signal_at, ob.last_event_at) < now() - interval '45 minutes' THEN 'stale'
                        WHEN ob.driver_last_used_at IS NOT NULL
                          AND ob.driver_last_used_at < now() - interval '2 hours' THEN 'stale'
                        ELSE 'healthy'
                    END
                )
                ORDER BY COALESCE(ob.last_signal_at, ob.last_event_at, ob.driver_last_used_at) DESC NULLS LAST
            ),
            '[]'::jsonb
        )
        FROM op_base ob
    );
END;
$function$

        END

 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_document public.billing_documents%rowtype;
    v_line_id uuid := NULLIF(p_line->>'id', '')::uuid;
    v_next_line_number int;
BEGIN
    SELECT *
    INTO v_document
    FROM private.fiscal02_legacy_billing_documents
    WHERE id = p_document_id;

    IF v_document.id IS NULL THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'document_not_found');
    END IF;

    IF NOT public.billing_user_has_tenant(v_document.tenant_id, ARRAY['admin', 'operator']) THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'unauthorized');
    END IF;

    IF v_document.status IN ('queued', 'stamped', 'cancelled', 'voided') THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'document_locked');
    END IF;

    IF v_line_id IS NOT NULL THEN
        UPDATE public.billing_document_lines
        SET line_number = COALESCE(NULLIF(p_line->>'line_number', '')::int, line_number),
            description = COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(p_line->>'description', '')), ''), description),
            product_service_key = CASE WHEN p_line ? 'product_service_key' THEN NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(p_line->>'product_service_key', '')), '') ELSE product_service_key END,
            unit_key = CASE WHEN p_line ? 'unit_key' THEN NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(p_line->>'unit_key', '')), '') ELSE unit_key END,
            unit_name = CASE WHEN p_line ? 'unit_name' THEN NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(p_line->>'unit_name', '')), '') ELSE unit_name END,
            identification_number = CASE WHEN p_line ? 'identification_number' THEN NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(p_line->>'identification_number', '')), '') ELSE identification_number END,
            quantity = COALESCE(NULLIF(p_line->>'quantity', '')::numeric, quantity),
            unit_price = COALESCE(NULLIF(p_line->>'unit_price', '')::numeric, unit_price),
            discount = COALESCE(NULLIF(p_line->>'discount', '')::numeric, discount),
            object_tax_code = CASE WHEN p_line ? 'object_tax_code' THEN NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(p_line->>'object_tax_code', '')), '') ELSE object_tax_code END,
            notes = CASE WHEN p_line ? 'notes' THEN p_line->>'notes' ELSE notes END,
            metadata = CASE WHEN p_line ? 'metadata' THEN COALESCE(p_line->'metadata', '{}'::jsonb) ELSE metadata END,
            updated_at = now()
        WHERE id = v_line_id
          AND document_id = p_document_id
          AND tenant_id = v_document.tenant_id;

        IF NOT FOUND THEN
            RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'line_not_found');
        END IF;
    ELSE
        SELECT COALESCE(max(line_number), 0) + 1
        INTO v_next_line_number
        FROM public.billing_document_lines
        WHERE document_id = p_document_id;

        INSERT INTO public.billing_document_lines (
            tenant_id,
            document_id,
            operation_id,
            line_number,
            description,
            product_service_key,
            unit_key,
            unit_name,
            identification_number,
            quantity,
            unit_price,
            discount,
            object_tax_code,
            notes,
            metadata
        ) VALUES (
            v_document.tenant_id,
            p_document_id,
            v_document.operation_id,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(p_line->>'line_number', '')::int, v_next_line_number),
            COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(p_line->>'description', '')), ''), 'Concepto fiscal'),
            NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(p_line->>'product_service_key', '')), ''),
            NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(p_line->>'unit_key', '')), ''),
            NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(p_line->>'unit_name', '')), ''),
            NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(p_line->>'identification_number', '')), ''),
            COALESCE(NULLIF(p_line->>'quantity', '')::numeric, 1),
            COALESCE(NULLIF(p_line->>'unit_price', '')::numeric, 0),
            COALESCE(NULLIF(p_line->>'discount', '')::numeric, 0),
            NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(p_line->>'object_tax_code', '')), ''),
            p_line->>'notes',
            COALESCE(p_line->'metadata', '{}'::jsonb)
        )
        RETURNING id INTO v_line_id;
    END IF;

    PERFORM public.billing_recalculate_document_totals(p_document_id);

    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
        'success', true,
        'id', v_line_id,
        'document', public.billing_fiscal_document_json(p_document_id)
    );
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', SQLERRM);
END;
$function$

 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_document public.billing_documents%rowtype;
    v_party_id uuid := NULLIF(p_party->>'id', '')::uuid;
    v_role text := NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(p_party->>'role', '')), '');
BEGIN
    SELECT *
    INTO v_document
    FROM private.fiscal02_legacy_billing_documents
    WHERE id = p_document_id;

    END IF;

    IF NOT public.billing_user_has_tenant(v_document.tenant_id, ARRAY['admin', 'operator']) THEN

    END IF;

    IF v_document.status IN ('queued', 'stamped', 'cancelled', 'voided') THEN

    END IF;

    IF v_role IS NULL OR v_role NOT IN ('issuer', 'receiver', 'provider', 'payer', 'payee') THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'invalid_party_role');
    END IF;

    IF v_party_id IS NULL THEN
        SELECT id
        INTO v_party_id

        WHERE document_id = p_document_id
          AND role = v_role;
    END IF;

            fiscal_postal_code = CASE WHEN p_party ? 'fiscal_postal_code' THEN NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(p_party->>'fiscal_postal_code', '')), '') ELSE fiscal_postal_code END,

            updated_at = now()
        WHERE id = v_party_id
          AND document_id = p_document_id
          AND tenant_id = v_document.tenant_id;
    ELSE
        INSERT INTO public.billing_document_parties (
            tenant_id,
            document_id,
            role,
            customer_id,
            provider_id,
            rfc,
            legal_name,
            fiscal_regime_code,
            fiscal_postal_code,
            email,
            metadata
        ) VALUES (
            v_document.tenant_id,
            p_document_id,
            v_role,
            NULLIF(p_party->>'customer_id', '')::uuid,
            NULLIF(p_party->>'provider_id', '')::uuid,
            NULLIF(upper(trim(COALESCE(p_party->>'rfc', ''))), ''),
            NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(p_party->>'legal_name', '')), ''),
            NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(p_party->>'fiscal_regime_code', '')), ''),
            NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(p_party->>'fiscal_postal_code', '')), ''),
            NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(p_party->>'email', '')), ''),
            COALESCE(p_party->'metadata', '{}'::jsonb)
        )
        RETURNING id INTO v_party_id;
    END IF;

    UPDATE public.billing_documents
    SET updated_at = now()
    WHERE id = p_document_id;

    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
        'success', true,
        'id', v_party_id,
        'document', public.billing_fiscal_document_json(p_document_id)
    );
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', SQLERRM);
END;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_upsert_document_template_v2(p_tenant_id uuid, p_payload jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_template_id uuid := NULLIF(p_payload->>'id', '')::uuid;
    v_template_type text := COALESCE(NULLIF(p_payload->>'template_type', ''), 'finance_note');
    v_name text := trim(COALESCE(p_payload->>'name', ''));
    v_layout_key text := COALESCE(NULLIF(p_payload->>'layout_key', ''), 'standard');
    v_tokens text[] := ARRAY[]::text[];
    v_visible_fields jsonb := COALESCE(p_payload->'visible_fields', '[]'::jsonb);
    v_brand_settings jsonb := COALESCE(p_payload->'brand_settings', '{}'::jsonb);
    v_version_number integer;
    v_version_id uuid;
BEGIN
    IF NOT public.tanda4_user_has_role(p_tenant_id, ARRAY['admin', 'finance']) THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'unauthorized');
    END IF;

    IF v_name = '' THEN
        v_name := public.tanda4_document_type_label(v_template_type) || ' ROTERO';
    END IF;

    IF jsonb_typeof(COALESCE(p_payload->'tokens', '[]'::jsonb)) = 'array' THEN
        SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(value), ARRAY[]::text[]) INTO v_tokens
        FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(p_payload->'tokens', '[]'::jsonb)) AS token(value);
    END IF;

    IF jsonb_typeof(v_visible_fields) <> 'array' THEN
        v_visible_fields := '[]'::jsonb;
    END IF;

    IF v_template_id IS NULL THEN
        INSERT INTO public.document_templates (
            tenant_id,
            template_type,
            name,
            version,
            title,
            body_text,
            footer_text,
            legal_notes,
            tokens,
            brand_settings,
            is_active,
            module,
            layout_key,
            visible_fields,
            status,
            created_by
        )
        VALUES (
            p_tenant_id,
            v_template_type,
            v_name,
            1,
            COALESCE(p_payload->>'title', public.tanda4_document_type_label(v_template_type)),
            COALESCE(p_payload->>'body_text', ''),
            COALESCE(p_payload->>'footer_text', ''),
            COALESCE(p_payload->>'legal_notes', ''),
            v_tokens,
            v_brand_settings,
            COALESCE((p_payload->>'is_active')::boolean, true),
            COALESCE(NULLIF(p_payload->>'module', ''), CASE
                WHEN v_template_type IN ('payment_complement', 'credit_note', 'provider_document', 'finance_internal_receipt', 'finance_note') THEN 'finance'
                WHEN v_template_type = 'payroll_receipt' THEN 'payroll'
                WHEN v_template_type IN ('operation_summary', 'operation_document') THEN 'operations'
                ELSE 'commercial'
            END),
            v_layout_key,
            v_visible_fields,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(p_payload->>'status', ''), 'active'),
            auth.uid()
        )
        RETURNING id INTO v_template_id;

        v_version_number := 1;
    ELSE
        IF NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM public.document_templates
            WHERE id = v_template_id
              AND tenant_id = p_tenant_id
        ) THEN
            RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'template_not_found');
        END IF;

        SELECT COALESCE(max(version_number), 0) + 1 INTO v_version_number
        FROM public.document_template_versions
        WHERE template_id = v_template_id;

        UPDATE public.document_templates
        SET template_type = v_template_type,
            name = v_name,
            version = v_version_number,
            title = COALESCE(p_payload->>'title', title),
            body_text = COALESCE(p_payload->>'body_text', body_text),
            footer_text = COALESCE(p_payload->>'footer_text', footer_text),
            legal_notes = COALESCE(p_payload->>'legal_notes', legal_notes),
            tokens = v_tokens,
            brand_settings = v_brand_settings,
            is_active = COALESCE((p_payload->>'is_active')::boolean, is_active),
            module = COALESCE(NULLIF(p_payload->>'module', ''), module),
            layout_key = v_layout_key,
            visible_fields = v_visible_fields,
            status = COALESCE(NULLIF(p_payload->>'status', ''), status),
            updated_at = now()
        WHERE id = v_template_id;
    END IF;

    UPDATE public.document_template_versions
    SET status = 'archived'
    WHERE template_id = v_template_id
      AND status = 'active';

    INSERT INTO public.document_template_versions (
        tenant_id,
        template_id,
        version_number,
        template_type,
        name,
        layout_key,
        title,
        body_text,
        footer_text,
        legal_notes,
        tokens,
        visible_fields,
        brand_settings,
        status,
        created_by,
        activated_at
    )
    SELECT
        t.tenant_id,
        t.id,
        v_version_number,
        t.template_type,
        t.name,
        t.layout_key,
        t.title,
        t.body_text,
        t.footer_text,
        t.legal_notes,
        t.tokens,
        t.visible_fields,
        t.brand_settings,
        'active',
        auth.uid(),
        now()
    FROM public.document_templates t
    WHERE t.id = v_template_id
    RETURNING id INTO v_version_id;

    UPDATE public.document_templates
    SET active_version_id = v_version_id,
        updated_at = now()
    WHERE id = v_template_id;

    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'id', v_template_id, 'version_id', v_version_id);
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_upsert_service_catalog_item(p_tenant_id uuid, p_payload jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_id uuid := NULLIF(p_payload->>'id', '')::uuid;
    v_service_type text := NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(p_payload->>'service_type', '')), '');
    v_service_class text := NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(p_payload->>'service_class', '')), '');
    v_presentation text := NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(p_payload->>'presentation', '')), '');
    v_packaging text := NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(p_payload->>'packaging', '')), '');
    v_modality text := NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(p_payload->>'modality', '')), '');
    v_is_active boolean := COALESCE((p_payload->>'is_active')::boolean, true);
    v_saved public.service_catalog_items%rowtype;
BEGIN
    IF NOT public.tanda1_user_has_role(p_tenant_id, ARRAY['admin', 'operator']) THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'unauthorized');
    END IF;

    IF v_service_type IS NULL THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'missing_service_type');
    END IF;

    IF v_id IS NULL THEN
        UPDATE public.service_catalog_items
        SET is_active = v_is_active,
            updated_at = now()
        WHERE tenant_id = p_tenant_id
          AND lower(btrim(service_type)) = lower(btrim(v_service_type))
          AND lower(btrim(COALESCE(service_class, ''))) = lower(btrim(COALESCE(v_service_class, '')))
          AND lower(btrim(COALESCE(presentation, ''))) = lower(btrim(COALESCE(v_presentation, '')))
          AND lower(btrim(COALESCE(packaging, ''))) = lower(btrim(COALESCE(v_packaging, '')))
          AND lower(btrim(COALESCE(modality, ''))) = lower(btrim(COALESCE(v_modality, '')))
        RETURNING * INTO v_saved;

        IF v_saved.id IS NULL THEN
            INSERT INTO public.service_catalog_items (
                tenant_id,
                service_type,
                service_class,
                presentation,
                packaging,
                modality,
                is_active
            ) VALUES (
                p_tenant_id,
                v_service_type,
                v_service_class,
                v_presentation,
                v_packaging,
                v_modality,
                v_is_active
            )
            RETURNING * INTO v_saved;
        END IF;
    ELSE
        UPDATE public.service_catalog_items
        SET service_type = v_service_type,
            service_class = v_service_class,
            presentation = v_presentation,
            packaging = v_packaging,
            modality = v_modality,
            is_active = v_is_active,
            updated_at = now()
        WHERE id = v_id
          AND tenant_id = p_tenant_id
        RETURNING * INTO v_saved;
    END IF;

    IF v_saved.id IS NULL THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'not_found');
    END IF;

    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
        'success', true,
        'item', jsonb_build_object(
            'id', v_saved.id,
            'tenant_id', v_saved.tenant_id,
            'service_type', v_saved.service_type,
            'service_class', v_saved.service_class,
            'presentation', v_saved.presentation,
            'packaging', v_saved.packaging,
            'modality', v_saved.modality,
            'is_active', v_saved.is_active,
            'created_at', v_saved.created_at,
            'updated_at', v_saved.updated_at
        )
    );
EXCEPTION WHEN unique_violation THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'service_catalog_duplicate');
END;
$function$
