CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tanda4_ensure_document_template(p_tenant_id uuid, p_template_type text)
 RETURNS TABLE(template_id uuid, version_id uuid)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_template_id uuid;
    v_version_id uuid;
    v_label text := public.tanda4_document_type_label(p_template_type);
BEGIN
    SELECT t.id, t.active_version_id
    INTO v_template_id, v_version_id
    FROM public.document_templates t
    WHERE t.tenant_id = p_tenant_id
      AND t.template_type = p_template_type
      AND t.is_active
      AND t.status = 'active'
    ORDER BY t.updated_at DESC NULLS LAST, t.created_at DESC
    LIMIT 1;

    IF v_template_id IS NULL THEN
        INSERT INTO public.document_templates (
            tenant_id,
            template_type,
            name,
            version,
            title,
            body_text,
            footer_text,
            legal_notes,
            tokens,
            brand_settings,
            is_active,
            module,
            layout_key,
            visible_fields,
            status,
            created_by
        )
        VALUES (
            p_tenant_id,
            p_template_type,
            v_label || ' ROTERO',
            1,
            v_label,
            'Documento generado desde ROTERO ERP.',
            'ROTERO ERP',
            'Documento interno/controlado. No sustituye timbrado fiscal cuando aplique.',
            ARRAY['brand.name', 'document.number', 'document.date'],
            '{}'::jsonb,
            true,
            CASE
                WHEN p_template_type IN ('payment_complement', 'credit_note', 'provider_document', 'finance_internal_receipt', 'finance_note') THEN 'finance'
                WHEN p_template_type = 'payroll_receipt' THEN 'payroll'
                WHEN p_template_type IN ('operation_summary', 'operation_document') THEN 'operations'
                ELSE 'commercial'
            END,
            'standard',
            '[]'::jsonb,
            'active',
            auth.uid()
        )
        RETURNING id INTO v_template_id;
    END IF;

    IF v_version_id IS NULL THEN
        SELECT v.id INTO v_version_id
        FROM public.document_template_versions v
        WHERE v.template_id = v_template_id
          AND v.status = 'active'
        ORDER BY v.version_number DESC
        LIMIT 1;
    END IF;

    IF v_version_id IS NULL THEN
        INSERT INTO public.document_template_versions (
            tenant_id,
            template_id,
            version_number,
            template_type,
            name,
            layout_key,
            title,
            body_text,
            footer_text,
            legal_notes,
            tokens,
            visible_fields,
            brand_settings,
            status,
            created_by,
            activated_at
        )
        SELECT
            t.tenant_id,
            t.id,
            COALESCE(t.version, 1),
            t.template_type,
            t.name,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(t.layout_key, ''), 'standard'),
            t.title,
            t.body_text,
            t.footer_text,
            t.legal_notes,
            t.tokens,
            COALESCE(t.visible_fields, '[]'::jsonb),
            t.brand_settings,
            'active',
            auth.uid(),
            now()
        FROM public.document_templates t
        WHERE t.id = v_template_id
        RETURNING id INTO v_version_id;
    END IF;

    UPDATE public.document_templates
    SET active_version_id = v_version_id,
        updated_at = now()
    WHERE id = v_template_id
      AND active_version_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_version_id;

    RETURN QUERY SELECT v_template_id, v_version_id;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_assign_operation(p_tenant_id uuid, p_operation_id uuid, p_driver_id uuid, p_vehicle_id uuid, p_planned_departure timestamp with time zone, p_priority text DEFAULT 'normal'::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
DECLARE
  op_status text;
BEGIN
  -- 1. Get current status and verify operation ownership
  SELECT status INTO op_status
  FROM public.operations
  WHERE id = p_operation_id AND tenant_id = p_tenant_id;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'operation_not_found');
  END IF;

  -- 2. Update operation
  -- Note: updated_at is handled by the set_updated_at trigger
  UPDATE public.operations
  SET
    driver_id = p_driver_id,
    vehicle_id = p_vehicle_id,
    planned_departure = p_planned_departure,
    priority = p_priority,
    status = 'assigned',
    assigned_at = now()
  WHERE id = p_operation_id AND tenant_id = p_tenant_id;

  -- 3. Audit Log with latest schema (metadata + actor_user_id)
  INSERT INTO public.audit_log (
    tenant_id,
    actor_user_id,
    action,
    entity_type,
    entity_id,
    metadata
  )
  VALUES (
    p_tenant_id,
    auth.uid(),
    'status_changed',
    'operation',
    p_operation_id,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'old_status', op_status,
      'new_status', 'assigned',
      'changed_fields', jsonb_build_array('driver_id','vehicle_id','planned_departure','priority'),
      'driver_id', p_driver_id,
      'vehicle_id', p_vehicle_id,
      'planned_departure', p_planned_departure,
      'priority', p_priority
    )
  );

  RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true);
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_create_pedimento(p_tenant_id uuid, p_payload jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
DECLARE
    new_id uuid;
    v_pedimento_number text;
BEGIN
    IF NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM memberships m
        WHERE m.user_id = auth.uid()
          AND m.tenant_id = p_tenant_id
          AND m.role IN ('admin', 'operator')
    ) THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'unauthorized');
    END IF;

    v_pedimento_number := p_payload->>'pedimento_number';
    IF v_pedimento_number IS NULL OR length(v_pedimento_number) < 10 THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'invalid format for pedimento_number (min length 10)');
    END IF;
    
    INSERT INTO customs_pedimentos (
        tenant_id, 
        pedimento_number, 
        aduana, 
        regimen, 
        tipo_operacion, 
        fecha_pago, 
        total_value, 
        currency, 
        status
    )
    VALUES (
        p_tenant_id, 
        v_pedimento_number,
        p_payload->>'aduana',
        p_payload->>'regimen',
        COALESCE(p_payload->>'tipo_operacion', 'import'),
        (p_payload->>'fecha_pago')::timestamptz,
        (p_payload->>'total_value')::numeric,
        COALESCE(p_payload->>'currency', 'MXN'),
        COALESCE(p_payload->>'status', 'draft')
    )
    RETURNING id INTO new_id;
    
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'id', new_id);
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', SQLERRM);
END;
$function$

    v_template_id uuid;

BEGIN
    IF p_template_type IN ('payment_complement', 'credit_note', 'provider_document', 'finance_internal_receipt', 'finance_note', 'payroll_receipt') THEN
        IF NOT public.tanda4_user_has_role(p_tenant_id, ARRAY['admin', 'finance']) THEN
            RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'unauthorized');
        END IF;
    ELSE
        IF NOT public.tanda4_user_has_role(p_tenant_id, ARRAY['admin', 'operator', 'finance']) THEN
            RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'unauthorized');
        END IF;
    END IF;

    SELECT template_id, version_id
    INTO v_template_id, v_version_id
    FROM public.tanda4_ensure_document_template(p_tenant_id, p_template_type);

    IF p_template_type = 'commercial_quote' THEN
        SELECT jsonb_build_object(
            'title', 'Cotizacion',
            'source_label', COALESCE(d.quote_reference, d.title),
            'fields', jsonb_build_array(
                jsonb_build_object('label', 'Folio', 'value', COALESCE(d.quote_reference, 'Sin folio')),
                jsonb_build_object('label', 'Cliente', 'value', COALESCE(c.display_name, d.company, 'Sin cliente')),
                jsonb_build_object('label', 'Contacto', 'value', COALESCE(d.contact_name, d.contact_email, 'Sin contacto')),
                jsonb_build_object('label', 'Servicio', 'value', COALESCE(d.quote_payload->>'service_type', d.quote_payload#>>'{service_catalog_snapshot,service_type}', 'Sin tipo')),
                jsonb_build_object('label', 'Clase', 'value', COALESCE(d.quote_payload->>'service_class', d.quote_payload#>>'{service_catalog_snapshot,service_class}', 'Sin clase')),
                jsonb_build_object('label', 'Ruta', 'value', COALESCE(d.quote_payload->>'route_summary', 'Sin ruta')),
                jsonb_build_object('label', 'Alcance', 'value', COALESCE(d.quote_payload->>'operation_scope', 'Sin alcance')),
                jsonb_build_object('label', 'Estatus', 'value', d.quote_status)
            ),
            'amounts', jsonb_build_array(
                jsonb_build_object('label', 'Precio cliente', 'value', public.tanda4_money(COALESCE(NULLIF(d.quote_payload->>'customer_price_amount', '')::numeric, d.value), COALESCE(NULLIF(d.quote_payload->>'pricing_currency', ''), d.currency, 'MXN')))
            ),
            'notes', COALESCE(d.quote_payload->>'notes', d.notes, '')
        )
        INTO v_data
        FROM public.crm_deals d
        LEFT JOIN public.customers c ON c.id = d.customer_id
        WHERE d.id = p_entity_id
          AND d.tenant_id = p_tenant_id;
    ELSIF p_template_type IN ('operation_summary', 'operation_document') THEN
        SELECT jsonb_build_object(
            'title', 'Resumen operativo',
            'source_label', o.reference_code,
            'fields', jsonb_build_array(
                jsonb_build_object('label', 'Operacion', 'value', o.reference_code),
                jsonb_build_object('label', 'Cliente', 'value', COALESCE(c.display_name, o.client_display_name, 'Sin cliente')),
                jsonb_build_object('label', 'Ruta', 'value', COALESCE(o.route_summary, 'Sin ruta')),
                jsonb_build_object('label', 'Destino', 'value', COALESCE(o.destination_city, o.destination_place->>'city', 'Sin destino')),
                jsonb_build_object('label', 'Estatus', 'value', o.status),
                jsonb_build_object('label', 'Servicio', 'value', COALESCE(o.service_type, o.service_catalog_snapshot->>'service_type', 'Sin tipo')),
                jsonb_build_object('label', 'Cajas colocadas', 'value', COALESCE(o.boxes_placed_days::text, 'Sin captura')),
                jsonb_build_object('label', 'Documentacion recibida', 'value', COALESCE(o.documentation_received_at::date::text, 'Pendiente')),
                jsonb_build_object('label', 'Documentos presentes', 'value', (
                    SELECT count(*)::text
                    FROM public.operation_documents od
                    WHERE od.operation_id = o.id
                      AND od.status = 'present'
                ))
            ),
            'amounts', jsonb_build_array(
                jsonb_build_object('label', 'Precio cliente', 'value', public.tanda4_money(o.customer_price_amount, o.pricing_currency)),
                jsonb_build_object('label', 'Costo proveedor', 'value', public.tanda4_money(o.provider_cost_amount, o.pricing_currency))
            ),
            'notes', COALESCE(o.documentation_received_note, o.cargo_summary->>'description', '')
        )
        INTO v_data
        FROM public.operations o
        LEFT JOIN public.customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
        WHERE o.id = p_entity_id
          AND o.tenant_id = p_tenant_id;
    ELSIF p_template_type = 'payment_complement' THEN
        SELECT jsonb_build_object(
            'title', 'Complemento de pago interno',
            'source_label', COALESCE(fi.reference, pc.id::text),
            'fields', jsonb_build_array(
                jsonb_build_object('label', 'Factura', 'value', COALESCE(fi.reference, COALESCE(c.serie, '') || COALESCE(c.folio, ''), 'Sin referencia')),
                jsonb_build_object('label', 'Contraparte', 'value', COALESCE(fi.counterparty_name, c.receptor_name, 'Sin contraparte')),
                jsonb_build_object('label', 'Fecha de pago', 'value', pc.payment_date::date::text),
                jsonb_build_object('label', 'Metodo', 'value', pc.method),
                jsonb_build_object('label', 'Referencia bancaria', 'value', COALESCE(pc.bank_reference, 'Sin referencia')),
                jsonb_build_object('label', 'Estatus', 'value', pc.status)
            ),
            'amounts', jsonb_build_array(
                jsonb_build_object('label', 'Monto original', 'value', public.tanda4_money(pc.amount, pc.currency)),
                jsonb_build_object('label', 'Monto MXN', 'value', public.tanda4_money(pc.amount_mxn, 'MXN'))
            ),
            'notes', COALESCE(pc.notes, '')
        )
        INTO v_data
        FROM private.fiscal02_legacy_billing_payment_complements pc
        LEFT JOIN private.fiscal02_legacy_finance_invoices fi ON fi.id = pc.finance_invoice_id
        LEFT JOIN private.fiscal02_readable_cfdis c ON c.id = pc.cfdi_id
        WHERE pc.id = p_entity_id
          AND pc.tenant_id = p_tenant_id;
        v_relation_type := 'payment_to_invoice';
    ELSIF p_template_type IN ('credit_note', 'provider_document') THEN
        SELECT jsonb_build_object(
            'title', CASE WHEN cn.note_type = 'provider_credit' THEN 'Documento proveedor' ELSE 'Nota de credito' END,
            'source_label', COALESCE(cn.folio, cn.provider_note_reference, cn.id::text),
            'fields', jsonb_build_array(
                jsonb_build_object('label', 'Folio/referencia', 'value', COALESCE(cn.folio, cn.provider_note_reference, 'Sin folio')),
                jsonb_build_object('label', 'Tipo', 'value', cn.note_type),
                jsonb_build_object('label', 'Cliente', 'value', COALESCE(cust.display_name, 'No aplica')),
                jsonb_build_object('label', 'Proveedor', 'value', COALESCE(lp.display_name, 'No aplica')),
                jsonb_build_object('label', 'Operacion', 'value', COALESCE(o.reference_code, 'Sin operacion')),
                jsonb_build_object('label', 'Factura/AP', 'value', COALESCE(fi.reference, 'Sin liga')),
                jsonb_build_object('label', 'Fecha', 'value', cn.issue_date::text),
                jsonb_build_object('label', 'Estatus', 'value', cn.status)
            ),
            'amounts', jsonb_build_array(
                jsonb_build_object('label', 'Subtotal', 'value', public.tanda4_money(cn.subtotal, cn.currency)),
                jsonb_build_object('label', 'IVA', 'value', public.tanda4_money(cn.iva, cn.currency)),
                jsonb_build_object('label', 'Total', 'value', public.tanda4_money(cn.total, cn.currency)),
                jsonb_build_object('label', 'Total MXN', 'value', public.tanda4_money(cn.total_mxn, 'MXN'))
            ),
            'notes', COALESCE(cn.reason, cn.notes, '')
        )
        INTO v_data
        FROM private.fiscal02_legacy_billing_credit_notes cn
        LEFT JOIN public.customers cust ON cust.id = cn.customer_id
        LEFT JOIN public.logistics_providers lp ON lp.id = cn.provider_id
        LEFT JOIN public.operations o ON o.id = cn.operation_id
        LEFT JOIN private.fiscal02_legacy_finance_invoices fi ON fi.id = cn.finance_invoice_id
        WHERE cn.id = p_entity_id
          AND cn.tenant_id = p_tenant_id;
        v_relation_type := CASE WHEN p_template_type = 'provider_document' THEN 'provider_doc_to_ap' ELSE 'credit_note_to_invoice' END;
    ELSIF p_template_type = 'payroll_receipt' THEN
        SELECT jsonb_build_object(
            'title', 'Recibo interno de nomina',
            'source_label', pr.folio,
            'fields', jsonb_build_array(
                jsonb_build_object('label', 'Folio', 'value', pr.folio),
                jsonb_build_object('label', 'Empleado', 'value', pe.display_name),
                jsonb_build_object('label', 'Codigo', 'value', COALESCE(pe.employee_code, 'Sin codigo')),
                jsonb_build_object('label', 'Periodo', 'value', pp.name),
                jsonb_build_object('label', 'Inicio', 'value', pp.period_start::text),
                jsonb_build_object('label', 'Fin', 'value', pp.period_end::text),
                jsonb_build_object('label', 'Estatus', 'value', pr.status)
            ),
            'amounts', jsonb_build_array(
                jsonb_build_object('label', 'Bruto', 'value', public.tanda4_money(pe2.gross_amount, 'MXN')),
                jsonb_build_object('label', 'Deducciones', 'value', public.tanda4_money(pe2.absence_deduction + pe2.loan_deduction + pe2.discount_deduction + pe2.manual_tax_amount, 'MXN')),
                jsonb_build_object('label', 'Neto', 'value', public.tanda4_money(pe2.net_amount, 'MXN'))
            ),
            'notes', COALESCE(pe2.notes, '')
        )
        INTO v_data
        FROM public.payroll_receipts pr
        JOIN public.payroll_employees pe ON pe.id = pr.employee_id
        JOIN public.payroll_periods pp ON pp.id = pr.period_id
        JOIN public.payroll_entries pe2 ON pe2.id = pr.entry_id
        WHERE pr.id = p_entity_id
          AND pr.tenant_id = p_tenant_id;
        v_relation_type := 'payroll_receipt_to_period';
    ELSIF p_template_type = 'finance_internal_receipt' THEN
        SELECT jsonb_build_object(
            'title', 'Comprobante interno financiero',
            'source_label', COALESCE(fi.reference, fi.id::text),
            'fields', jsonb_build_array(
                jsonb_build_object('label', 'Referencia', 'value', COALESCE(fi.reference, 'Sin referencia')),
                jsonb_build_object('label', 'Direccion', 'value', fi.direction),
                jsonb_build_object('label', 'Contraparte', 'value', fi.counterparty_name),
                jsonb_build_object('label', 'Vencimiento', 'value', COALESCE(fi.due_date::text, 'Sin vencimiento')),
                jsonb_build_object('label', 'Estatus', 'value', fi.status)
            ),
            'amounts', jsonb_build_array(
                jsonb_build_object('label', 'Monto', 'value', public.tanda4_money(fi.amount, fi.currency)),
                jsonb_build_object('label', 'Monto MXN', 'value', public.tanda4_money(fi.amount_mxn, 'MXN'))
            ),
            'notes', COALESCE(fi.notes, '')
        )
        INTO v_data
        FROM private.fiscal02_legacy_finance_invoices fi
        WHERE fi.id = p_entity_id
          AND fi.tenant_id = p_tenant_id;
        v_relation_type := 'supporting_document';
    END IF;

    IF v_data IS NULL THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'source_not_found');
    END IF;

    IF v_requested_document_number IS NOT NULL THEN
        IF length(v_requested_document_number) > 80 THEN
            RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'document_number_too_long');
        END IF;

        IF v_requested_document_number !~ '^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9 _./-]{0,79}$' THEN
            RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'invalid_document_number');
        END IF;

        IF EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM public.generated_documents gd
            WHERE gd.tenant_id = p_tenant_id
              AND lower(gd.document_number) = lower(v_requested_document_number)
        ) THEN
            RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'duplicate_document_number');
        END IF;

        v_document_number := v_requested_document_number;
    ELSE
        v_document_prefix := public.tanda4_document_prefix(p_template_type) || '-' || to_char(now(), 'YYMM') || '-';

        SELECT (count(*) + 1)::int
        INTO v_sequence
        FROM public.generated_documents gd
        WHERE gd.tenant_id = p_tenant_id
          AND gd.entity_type = p_template_type
          AND date_trunc('month', gd.generated_at) = date_trunc('month', now());

        LOOP
            v_document_number := v_document_prefix || lpad(v_sequence::text, 4, '0');
            EXIT WHEN NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM public.generated_documents gd
                WHERE gd.tenant_id = p_tenant_id
                  AND lower(gd.document_number) = lower(v_document_number)
            );
            v_sequence := v_sequence + 1;
        END LOOP;
    END IF;

    v_html := public.tanda4_render_document_html(v_version_id, v_data, v_document_number);

    INSERT INTO public.generated_documents (
        tenant_id,
        template_id,
        template_version_id,
        entity_type,
        entity_id,
        status,
        html_snapshot,
        data_snapshot,
        generated_by,
        generated_at,
        document_number,
        source_module,
        related_entity_type,
        related_entity_id,
        finalized_at,
        metadata
    )
    VALUES (
        p_tenant_id,
        v_template_id,
        v_version_id,
        p_template_type,
        p_entity_id,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(p_options->>'status', ''), 'final'),
        v_html,
        v_data,
        auth.uid(),
        now(),
        v_document_number,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(p_options->>'source_module', ''), CASE
            WHEN p_template_type IN ('commercial_quote') THEN 'commercial'
            WHEN p_template_type IN ('operation_summary', 'operation_document') THEN 'operations'
            WHEN p_template_type = 'payroll_receipt' THEN 'payroll'
            ELSE 'finance'
        END),
        p_entity_type,
        p_entity_id,
        now(),
        jsonb_build_object(
            'template_type', p_template_type,
            'internal_only', p_template_type IN ('payment_complement', 'credit_note', 'provider_document', 'finance_internal_receipt'),
            'manual_document_number', v_requested_document_number IS NOT NULL
        )
    )
    RETURNING id INTO v_generated_id;

    INSERT INTO public.document_relations (
        tenant_id,
        relation_type,
        source_entity_type,
        source_entity_id,
        target_entity_type,
        target_entity_id,
        target_generated_document_id,
        notes,
        created_by
    )
    VALUES (
        p_tenant_id,
        v_relation_type,
        p_entity_type,
        p_entity_id,
        'generated_document',
        v_generated_id,
        v_generated_id,
        NULLIF(p_options->>'relation_notes', ''),
        auth.uid()
    );

    RETURN (
        SELECT to_jsonb(gd)
        FROM public.generated_documents gd
        WHERE gd.id = v_generated_id
    );
EXCEPTION WHEN unique_violation THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'duplicate_document_number');
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_get_cfdi_detail(p_cfdi_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_tenant_id uuid;
    res jsonb;
    cp jsonb;
BEGIN
    SELECT tenant_id INTO v_tenant_id
    FROM private.fiscal02_readable_cfdis
    WHERE id = p_cfdi_id;

    IF v_tenant_id IS NULL THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'not_found');
    END IF;

    IF NOT public.tanda2_user_has_role(v_tenant_id) THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'unauthorized');
    END IF;

    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
        'id', id,
        'uuid', uuid,
        'serie', serie,
        'folio', folio,
        'rfc_emisor', rfc_emisor,
        'rfc_receptor', rfc_receptor,
        'receptor_name', receptor_name,
        'subtotal', subtotal,
        'total', total,
        'currency', currency,
        'exchange_rate', exchange_rate,
        'exchange_rate_date', exchange_rate_date,
        'subtotal_mxn', subtotal_mxn,
        'iva_mxn', iva_mxn,
        'total_mxn', total_mxn,
        'status', status,
        'has_carta_porte', has_carta_porte,
        'has_complemento_pago', has_complemento_pago,
        'issued_at', issued_at,
        'cancelled_at', cancelled_at,
        'pac_provider', pac_provider,
        'notes', notes,
        'created_at', created_at,
        'updated_at', updated_at
    ) INTO res
    FROM private.fiscal02_readable_cfdis
    WHERE id = p_cfdi_id;

    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
        'id', id,
        'trans_type', trans_type,
        'vehicle_plate', vehicle_plate,
        'carrier_name', carrier_name,
        'origin', origin,
        'destination', destination,
        'goods_desc', goods_desc,
        'created_at', created_at
    ) INTO cp
    FROM public.billing_carta_porte
    WHERE cfdi_id = p_cfdi_id;

    IF cp IS NOT NULL THEN
        res := jsonb_set(res, '{carta_porte}', cp);
    END IF;

    RETURN res;
END;
$function$

public.rpc_get_driver_view(text).name: rpc_get_driver_view
public.rpc_get_driver_view(text).definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_get_driver_view(p_token text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_token RECORD;
    v_operation RECORD;
    v_last_status_evt_type text;
    v_last_any_evt_type text;
    v_last_location_municipality text;
    v_last_location_state_name text;
    v_last_location_timestamp timestamptz;
    v_status text;
BEGIN
    SELECT * INTO v_token
    FROM tracking_validate_token(p_token, 'driver:write');

    IF v_token IS NULL OR v_token.token_id IS NULL THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object('status', 'not_found');
    END IF;

    IF v_token.token_state = 'revoked' THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object('status', 'revoked');
    END IF;

    IF v_token.token_state IN ('hard_expired', 'soft_expired', 'rotated') OR v_token.expires_at < now() THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object('status', 'expired');
    END IF;

    SELECT
        o.reference_code,
        o.route_summary,
        LEFT(o.client_display_name, 20) AS client_name,
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(o.origin_place->>'municipality', ''),
            NULLIF(trim(split_part(COALESCE(o.route_summary, ''), ' - ', 1)), ''),
            'Origen no disponible'
        ) AS origin_city,
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(o.destination_place->>'municipality', ''),
            NULLIF(o.destination_city, ''),
            NULLIF(trim(split_part(COALESCE(o.route_summary, ''), ' - ', 2)), ''),
            'Destino no disponible'
        ) AS destination_city,
        o.eta_display
    INTO v_operation
    FROM operations o
    WHERE o.id = v_token.operation_id;

    IF v_operation IS NULL THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object('status', 'not_found');
    END IF;

    SELECT event_type
    INTO v_last_any_evt_type
    FROM tracking_events
    WHERE operation_id = v_token.operation_id
      AND event_type != 'incident'
    ORDER BY server_timestamp DESC
    LIMIT 1;

    SELECT event_type
    INTO v_last_status_evt_type
    FROM tracking_events
    WHERE operation_id = v_token.operation_id
      AND event_type IN ('departure', 'in_transit', 'arrival', 'delivered')
    ORDER BY server_timestamp DESC
    LIMIT 1;

    v_status := CASE
        WHEN v_last_status_evt_type IS NULL THEN 'assigned'
        WHEN v_last_status_evt_type = 'departure' THEN 'in_transit'
        WHEN v_last_status_evt_type = 'in_transit' THEN 'in_transit'
        WHEN v_last_status_evt_type = 'arrival' THEN 'at_destination'
        WHEN v_last_status_evt_type = 'delivered' THEN 'delivered'
        ELSE 'assigned'
    END;

    IF COALESCE(v_last_any_evt_type, '') <> 'location_reset' THEN
        SELECT
            municipality,
            state_name,
            server_timestamp
        INTO
            v_last_location_municipality,
            v_last_location_state_name,
            v_last_location_timestamp
        FROM tracking_events
        WHERE operation_id = v_token.operation_id
          AND municipality IS NOT NULL
          AND event_type NOT IN ('incident', 'location_reset')
        ORDER BY server_timestamp DESC
        LIMIT 1;
    END IF;

    UPDATE tracking_tokens
    SET last_used_at = now()
    WHERE id = v_token.token_id;

    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
        'status', 'success',
        'data', jsonb_build_object(
            'orderRef', v_operation.reference_code,
            'route', COALESCE(v_operation.route_summary, 'Ruta en curso'),
            'currentStatus', v_status,
            'eta', v_operation.eta_display,
            'clientName', v_operation.client_name,
            'originCity', v_operation.origin_city,
            'destinationCity', v_operation.destination_city,
            'lastEvent', CASE
                WHEN v_last_location_municipality IS NOT NULL THEN jsonb_build_object(
                    'municipality',
                    CASE
                        WHEN NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(v_last_location_state_name, '')), '') IS NOT NULL
                            THEN v_last_location_municipality || ', ' || v_last_location_state_name
                        ELSE v_last_location_municipality
                    END,
                    'timestamp', to_char(v_last_location_timestamp, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"')
                )
                ELSE NULL
            END
        )
    );
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_get_my_context()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
DECLARE
    result jsonb;
BEGIN
    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
        'user_id', auth.uid(),
        'email', (SELECT email FROM auth.users WHERE id = auth.uid()),
        'memberships', COALESCE((
            SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
                'tenant_id', m.tenant_id,
                'role', m.role,
                'tenant_name', t.name
            ))
            FROM memberships m
            JOIN tenants t ON t.id = m.tenant_id
            WHERE m.user_id = auth.uid()
        ), '[]'::jsonb)
    ) INTO result;
    
    RETURN result;
END;
$function$

public.rpc_get_operation(uuid).name: rpc_get_operation
public.rpc_get_operation(uuid).definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_get_operation(p_operation_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_tenant_id uuid;
    v_result jsonb;
BEGIN
    SELECT tenant_id INTO v_tenant_id
    FROM public.operations
    WHERE id = p_operation_id;

    IF v_tenant_id IS NULL THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'not_found');
    END IF;

    IF NOT public.tanda1_user_is_member(v_tenant_id) THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'unauthorized');
    END IF;

    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
        'id', o.id,
        'tenant_id', o.tenant_id,
        'reference_code', o.reference_code,

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_get_public_tracking(p_token text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_token RECORD;
    v_operation RECORD;
    v_events jsonb;
    v_route jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
    v_location jsonb;
    v_status_text text;
    v_route_label text;
    v_last_signal_at timestamptz;
    v_last_status_event_type text;
    v_last_public_event_type text;
    v_location_cleared boolean := false;
BEGIN
    SELECT * INTO v_token
    FROM tracking_validate_token(p_token, 'public:read');

    IF v_token IS NULL OR v_token.token_id IS NULL THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object('status', 'not_found');
    END IF;

    IF v_token.token_state = 'revoked' THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object('status', 'revoked');
    END IF;

    IF v_token.token_state = 'hard_expired' THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object('status', 'hard_expired');
    END IF;

    SELECT o.* INTO v_operation
    FROM operations o
    WHERE o.id = v_token.operation_id;

    IF v_operation IS NULL THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object('status', 'not_found');
    END IF;

    v_route_label := COALESCE(
        NULLIF((v_operation.origin_place->>'municipality') || ' -> ' || (v_operation.destination_place->>'municipality'), ' -> '),
        NULLIF(v_operation.route_summary, ''),
        'Ruta en curso'
    );

    SELECT te.event_type
    INTO v_last_public_event_type
    FROM tracking_events te
    WHERE te.operation_id = v_token.operation_id
      AND te.event_type != 'incident'
    ORDER BY te.server_timestamp DESC
    LIMIT 1;

    v_location_cleared := v_last_public_event_type = 'location_reset';

    SELECT te.event_type
    INTO v_last_status_event_type
    FROM tracking_events te
    WHERE te.operation_id = v_token.operation_id
      AND te.event_type IN ('departure', 'in_transit', 'arrival', 'delivered')
    ORDER BY te.server_timestamp DESC
    LIMIT 1;

    v_status_text := CASE
        WHEN v_last_status_event_type = 'arrival' THEN 'En Destino'
        WHEN v_last_status_event_type = 'delivered' THEN 'Entregado'
        WHEN v_last_status_event_type IN ('departure', 'in_transit') THEN 'En Camino'
        ELSE CASE v_operation.status
            WHEN 'draft' THEN 'Preparando'
            WHEN 'planned' THEN 'Planificado'
            WHEN 'assigned' THEN 'Asignado'
            WHEN 'in_transit' THEN 'En Camino'
            WHEN 'at_destination' THEN 'En Destino'
            WHEN 'delivered' THEN 'Entregado'
            WHEN 'closed' THEN 'Cerrado'
            WHEN 'cancelled' THEN 'Cancelado'
            ELSE v_operation.status
        END
    END;

    SELECT COALESCE(
        jsonb_agg(
            jsonb_build_object(
                'id', 'evt-' || row_number,
                'title', CASE te.event_type
                    WHEN 'departure' THEN 'Salida'
                    WHEN 'in_transit' THEN 'En camino'
                    WHEN 'arrival' THEN 'Llegada'
                    WHEN 'delivered' THEN 'Entregado'
                    ELSE te.event_type
                END,
                'subtitle', CASE te.event_type
                    WHEN 'departure' THEN 'Salida registrada'
                    WHEN 'in_transit' THEN 'Actualizacion en ruta'
                    WHEN 'arrival' THEN 'Llegada registrada'
                    WHEN 'delivered' THEN 'Entrega confirmada'
                    ELSE 'Evento de tracking'
                END,
                'location_label', CASE
                    WHEN NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(te.municipality, '')), '') IS NOT NULL
                         AND NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(te.state_name, '')), '') IS NOT NULL
                        THEN te.municipality || ', ' || te.state_name
                    WHEN NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(te.municipality, '')), '') IS NOT NULL
                        THEN te.municipality
                    WHEN te.event_type = 'departure'
                        THEN COALESCE(
                            NULLIF(v_operation.origin_place->>'municipality', ''),
                            NULLIF(v_operation.route_summary, ''),
                            'Ubicacion no disponible'
                        )
                    WHEN te.event_type IN ('arrival', 'delivered')
                        THEN COALESCE(
                            NULLIF(v_operation.destination_place->>'municipality', ''),
                            NULLIF(v_operation.destination_city, ''),
                            'Ubicacion no disponible'
                        )
                    ELSE 'Ubicacion no disponible'
                END,
                'timestamp', to_char(te.server_timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"'),
                'status', 'done',
                'icon', CASE te.event_type
                    WHEN 'departure' THEN 'truck'
                    WHEN 'in_transit' THEN 'map-pin'
                    WHEN 'arrival' THEN 'flag'
                    WHEN 'delivered' THEN 'check-circle'
                    ELSE 'clock'
                END
            )
            ORDER BY te.server_timestamp ASC
        ),
        '[]'::jsonb
    )
    INTO v_events
    FROM (
        SELECT *,
               row_number() OVER (ORDER BY server_timestamp ASC) AS row_number
        FROM tracking_events
        WHERE operation_id = v_token.operation_id
          AND event_type NOT IN ('incident', 'location_reset')
        ORDER BY server_timestamp ASC
        LIMIT 50
    ) te;

    IF v_operation.status NOT IN ('delivered', 'closed', 'cancelled') THEN
        IF NOT v_location_cleared THEN
            SELECT rp.recorded_at,
                   jsonb_build_object(
                       'lat', round(rp.lat::numeric, 2),
                       'lng', round(rp.lng::numeric, 2)
                   )
            INTO v_last_signal_at, v_location
            FROM tracking_route_points rp
            WHERE rp.operation_id = v_token.operation_id
            ORDER BY rp.recorded_at DESC
            LIMIT 1;

            IF v_location IS NULL THEN
                SELECT te.server_timestamp,
                       jsonb_build_object(
                           'lat', round(te.lat::numeric, 2),
                           'lng', round(te.lng::numeric, 2)
                       )
                INTO v_last_signal_at, v_location
                FROM tracking_events te
                WHERE te.operation_id = v_token.operation_id
                  AND te.lat IS NOT NULL
                  AND te.lng IS NOT NULL
                  AND te.source = 'gps'
                  AND te.event_type != 'location_reset'
                ORDER BY te.server_timestamp DESC
                LIMIT 1;
            END IF;
        ELSE
            SELECT rp.recorded_at
            INTO v_last_signal_at
            FROM tracking_route_points rp
            WHERE rp.operation_id = v_token.operation_id
            ORDER BY rp.recorded_at DESC
            LIMIT 1;
        END IF;

        SELECT COALESCE(
            jsonb_agg(
                jsonb_build_object(
                    'lat', round(rp.lat::numeric, 2),
                    'lng', round(rp.lng::numeric, 2)
                )
                ORDER BY rp.recorded_at ASC
            ),
            '[]'::jsonb
        )
        INTO v_route
        FROM (
            SELECT lat, lng, recorded_at
            FROM tracking_route_points
            WHERE operation_id = v_token.operation_id
            ORDER BY recorded_at ASC
            LIMIT 200
        ) rp;
    END IF;

    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
        'status', CASE WHEN v_token.token_state = 'soft_expired' THEN 'soft_expired' ELSE 'success' END,
        'data', jsonb_build_object(
            'orderRef', COALESCE(to_jsonb(v_operation)->>'reference_code', to_jsonb(v_operation)->>'reference', 'N/A'),
            'route', v_route_label,
            'currentStatus', v_status_text,
            'eta', NULLIF(COALESCE(to_jsonb(v_operation)->>'eta_display', to_jsonb(v_operation)->>'eta'), ''),
            'events', v_events,
            'locationCleared', v_location_cleared,
            'currentLocation', COALESCE(v_location, 'null'::jsonb),
            'routePoints', COALESCE(v_route, '[]'::jsonb),
            'lastSignalAt', CASE
                WHEN v_last_signal_at IS NOT NULL THEN to_char(v_last_signal_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"')
                ELSE NULL
            END
        )
    );
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_list_route_points(p_operation_id uuid, p_start timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone, p_end timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone, p_limit integer DEFAULT 2000)
 RETURNS TABLE(lat double precision, lng double precision, recorded_at timestamp with time zone, accuracy_m double precision, source text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_tenant_id uuid;
BEGIN
    SELECT tenant_id INTO v_tenant_id
    FROM operations WHERE id = p_operation_id;

    IF v_tenant_id IS NULL THEN RETURN; END IF;

    IF NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM memberships m
        WHERE m.user_id = auth.uid() AND m.tenant_id = v_tenant_id
    ) THEN RETURN; END IF;

    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT rp.lat, rp.lng, rp.recorded_at, rp.accuracy_m, rp.source
    FROM tracking_route_points rp
    WHERE rp.operation_id = p_operation_id
      AND (p_start IS NULL OR rp.recorded_at >= p_start)
      AND (p_end IS NULL OR rp.recorded_at <= p_end)
    ORDER BY rp.recorded_at ASC
    LIMIT LEAST(p_limit, 2000);
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_upsert_carta_porte(p_cfdi_id uuid, p_payload jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    cur_tenant_id uuid;
    cp_id uuid;
BEGIN
    SELECT tenant_id INTO cur_tenant_id
    FROM private.fiscal02_readable_cfdis
    WHERE id = p_cfdi_id;

    IF cur_tenant_id IS NULL THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'cfdi_not_found');
    END IF;

    IF NOT public.tanda1_user_has_role(cur_tenant_id, ARRAY['admin', 'finance']) THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'unauthorized');
    END IF;

    INSERT INTO public.billing_carta_porte (
        tenant_id,
        cfdi_id,
        trans_type,
        vehicle_plate,
        carrier_name,
        origin,
        destination,
        goods_desc
    ) VALUES (
        cur_tenant_id,
        p_cfdi_id,
        p_payload->>'trans_type',
        p_payload->>'vehicle_plate',
        p_payload->>'carrier_name',
        p_payload->>'origin',
        p_payload->>'destination',
        p_payload->>'goods_desc'
    )
    ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, cfdi_id) DO UPDATE SET
        trans_type = EXCLUDED.trans_type,
        vehicle_plate = EXCLUDED.vehicle_plate,
        carrier_name = EXCLUDED.carrier_name,
        origin = EXCLUDED.origin,
        destination = EXCLUDED.destination,
        goods_desc = EXCLUDED.goods_desc
    RETURNING id INTO cp_id;

    UPDATE public.billing_cfdis
    SET has_carta_porte = true,
        updated_at = now()
    WHERE id = p_cfdi_id;

    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'id', cp_id);
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', SQLERRM);
END;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tracking_validate_token(p_token text, p_scope text)
 RETURNS TABLE(token_id uuid, tenant_id uuid, operation_id uuid, token_state text, expires_at timestamp with time zone, delivered_at timestamp with time zone, event_count integer)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_hash TEXT;
    v_now  TIMESTAMPTZ := now();
BEGIN
    v_hash := tracking_hash_token(p_token);

    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT
        t.id,
        t.tenant_id,
        t.operation_id,
        -- Calcular estado efectivo en runtime (incluyendo soft/hard expiry)
        CASE
            WHEN t.state = 'revoked' THEN 'revoked'
            WHEN t.state = 'rotated' THEN 'rotated'
            WHEN t.state = 'hard_expired' THEN 'hard_expired'
            -- Expiración dinámica: si pasaron >48h del expires_at → hard_expired
            WHEN t.expires_at + INTERVAL '48 hours' < v_now THEN 'hard_expired'
            -- Si ya pasó expires_at pero aún no 48h → soft_expired
            WHEN t.expires_at < v_now THEN 'soft_expired'
            -- Post-entrega: delivered_at + 48h → soft_expired; +96h → hard_expired
            WHEN t.delivered_at IS NOT NULL
                 AND t.delivered_at + INTERVAL '96 hours' < v_now THEN 'hard_expired'
            WHEN t.delivered_at IS NOT NULL
                 AND t.delivered_at + INTERVAL '48 hours' < v_now THEN 'soft_expired'
            ELSE t.state
        END AS token_state,
        t.expires_at,
        t.delivered_at,
        t.event_count
    FROM tracking_tokens t
    WHERE t.token_hash = v_hash
      AND t.scope = p_scope
    LIMIT 1;

    -- NOTA: Si scope no coincide, no retorna filas → respuesta scope-blind (NL-16)
END;
$function$
